import {
  Injectable,
  BadRequestException,
  NotFoundException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { MfaSettings, User } from "@repo/database";
import {
  generateRegistrationOptions,
  verifyRegistrationResponse,
  generateAuthenticationOptions,
  verifyAuthenticationResponse,
  VerifiedRegistrationResponse,
  VerifiedAuthenticationResponse,
} from "@simplewebauthn/server";
import type {
  RegistrationResponseJSON,
  AuthenticationResponseJSON,
} from "@simplewebauthn/server";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import { type AuthenticatorTransportFuture } from "@simplewebauthn/server";

// Store challenges temporarily (use Redis in production!)
interface ChallengeEntry {
  challenge: string;
  expiresAt: Date;
}

const encoder = new TextEncoder();

@Injectable()
export class WebAuthnService {
  // In-memory store for challenges (replace with Redis!)
  private challenges = new Map<string, ChallengeEntry>();

  // WebAuthn configuration
  private readonly rpName = "Fort Knox";
  private readonly rpID: string;
  private readonly origin: string;

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(MfaSettings)
    private mfaRepository: Repository<MfaSettings>,
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
    private configService: ConfigService,
  ) {
    // Get from environment
    this.rpID = this.configService.get("WEBAUTHN_RP_ID") || "localhost";
    this.origin =
      this.configService.get("WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN") || "http://localhost:3000";

    // Cleanup expired challenges every 5 minutes
    setInterval(() => this.cleanupExpiredChallenges(), 5 * 60 * 1000);
  }

  /**
   * Start WebAuthn registration (generate options)
   */
  async startRegistration(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any> {
    // Get user
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: userId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    // Get or create MFA settings
    let mfaSettings = await this.mfaRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!mfaSettings) {
      mfaSettings = this.mfaRepository.create({
        userId,
        tenantId,
        webauthnCredentials: [],
      });
      await this.mfaRepository.save(mfaSettings);
    }

    // Get existing credentials (to exclude them)
    const existingCredentials = mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials.map((cred) => ({
      id: cred.id,
      type: "public-key" as const,
    }));

    // Generate registration options
    const options = await generateRegistrationOptions({
      rpName: this.rpName,
      rpID: this.rpID,
      userID: encoder.encode(userId),
      userName: user.email,
      userDisplayName: `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`,

      // Don't prompt for password
      attestationType: "none",

      // Exclude existing credentials
      excludeCredentials: existingCredentials,

      // Authenticator selection
      authenticatorSelection: {
        residentKey: "preferred",
        userVerification: "preferred",
        authenticatorAttachment: "platform", // Prefer platform authenticators (Face ID, Touch ID)
      },
    });

    // Store challenge (expires in 5 minutes)
    const key = `${userId}:${tenantId}:register`;
    this.challenges.set(key, {
      challenge: options.challenge,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000),
    });

    console.log("🔐 WebAuthn registration started for", user.email);

    return options;
  }

  /**
   * Finish WebAuthn registration (verify response)
   */
  async finishRegistration(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    response: RegistrationResponseJSON,
    deviceName?: string,
  ): Promise<{ credentialId: string }> {
    // Get stored challenge
    const key = `${userId}:${tenantId}:register`;
    const challengeEntry = this.challenges.get(key);

    if (!challengeEntry) {
      throw new BadRequestException("No registration in progress");
    }

    if (challengeEntry.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      this.challenges.delete(key);
      throw new BadRequestException("Registration challenge expired");
    }

    // Verify registration response
    let verification: VerifiedRegistrationResponse;

    try {
      verification = await verifyRegistrationResponse({
        response,
        expectedChallenge: challengeEntry.challenge,
        expectedOrigin: this.origin,
        expectedRPID: this.rpID,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("❌ WebAuthn registration verification failed:", error);
      throw new BadRequestException("Registration verification failed");
    }

    if (!verification.verified || !verification.registrationInfo) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Registration verification failed");
    }

    // Delete used challenge
    this.challenges.delete(key);

    // Get MFA settings
    const mfaSettings = await this.mfaRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!mfaSettings) {
      throw new NotFoundException("MFA settings not found");
    }

    // Store credential
    const { credential } = verification.registrationInfo;

    const {
      publicKey: credentialPublicKey,
      id: credentialID,
      counter,
    } = credential;

    const newCredential = {
      id: Buffer.from(credentialID).toString("base64url"),
      publicKey: Buffer.from(credentialPublicKey).toString("base64url"),
      counter,
      deviceName: deviceName || "Unnamed Device",
      createdAt: new Date(),
      lastUsedAt: new Date(),
      transports: response.response.transports || [],
    };

    mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials.push(newCredential);
    mfaSettings.webauthnEnabled = true;

    await this.mfaRepository.save(mfaSettings);

    console.log("✅ WebAuthn credential registered:", newCredential.id);

    return { credentialId: newCredential.id };
  }

  /**
   * Start WebAuthn authentication (generate options)
   */
  async startAuthentication(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any> {
    // Get MFA settings
    const mfaSettings = await this.mfaRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId, tenantId, webauthnEnabled: true },
    });

    if (!mfaSettings || mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException("WebAuthn not enabled for this user");
    }

    // Get user's credentials
    const allowCredentials = mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials.map((cred) => ({
      id: cred.id,
      type: "public-key" as const,
      transports: cred.transports as AuthenticatorTransportFuture[] | undefined,
    }));

    // Generate authentication options
    const options = await generateAuthenticationOptions({
      rpID: this.rpID,
      allowCredentials,
      userVerification: "preferred",
    });

    // Store challenge (expires in 5 minutes)
    const key = `${userId}:${tenantId}:authenticate`;
    this.challenges.set(key, {
      challenge: options.challenge,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000),
    });

    console.log("🔐 WebAuthn authentication started for user:", userId);

    return options;
  }

  /**
   * Finish WebAuthn authentication (verify response)
   */
  async finishAuthentication(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    response: AuthenticationResponseJSON,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    // Get stored challenge
    const key = `${userId}:${tenantId}:authenticate`;
    const challengeEntry = this.challenges.get(key);

    if (!challengeEntry) {
      throw new BadRequestException("No authentication in progress");
    }

    if (challengeEntry.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      this.challenges.delete(key);
      throw new BadRequestException("Authentication challenge expired");
    }

    // Get MFA settings
    const mfaSettings = await this.mfaRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId, tenantId, webauthnEnabled: true },
    });

    if (!mfaSettings) {
      throw new BadRequestException("WebAuthn not enabled");
    }

    // Find the credential
    const credentialId = Buffer.from(response.rawId, "base64url").toString(
      "base64url",
    );
    const credential = mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials.find(
      (cred) => cred.id === credentialId,
    );

    if (!credential) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Credential not found");
    }

    // Verify authentication response
    let verification: VerifiedAuthenticationResponse;

    try {
      verification = await verifyAuthenticationResponse({
        response,
        expectedChallenge: challengeEntry.challenge,
        expectedOrigin: this.origin,
        expectedRPID: this.rpID,
        credential: {
          id: credential.id,
          publicKey: Buffer.from(credential.publicKey, "base64url"),
          counter: credential.counter,
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("❌ WebAuthn authentication verification failed:", error);
      throw new BadRequestException("Authentication verification failed");
    }

    if (!verification.verified) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Authentication verification failed");
    }

    // Delete used challenge
    this.challenges.delete(key);

    // Update credential counter and last used
    credential.counter = verification.authenticationInfo.newCounter;
    credential.lastUsedAt = new Date();

    await this.mfaRepository.save(mfaSettings);

    console.log("✅ WebAuthn authentication verified:", credential.id);

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * List user's WebAuthn credentials
   */
  async listCredentials(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<
    Array<{
      id: string;
      deviceName: string;
      createdAt: Date;
      lastUsedAt?: Date;
      transports: string[];
    }>
  > {
    const mfaSettings = await this.mfaRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!mfaSettings) {
      return [];
    }

    return mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials.map((cred) => ({
      id: cred.id,
      deviceName: cred.deviceName || "Unnamed Device",
      createdAt: cred.createdAt,
      lastUsedAt: cred.lastUsedAt,
      transports: cred.transports || [],
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Delete a WebAuthn credential
   */
  async deleteCredential(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    credentialId: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const mfaSettings = await this.mfaRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!mfaSettings) {
      throw new NotFoundException("MFA settings not found");
    }

    // Remove credential
    mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials = mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials.filter(
      (cred) => cred.id !== credentialId,
    );

    // Disable WebAuthn if no credentials left
    if (mfaSettings.webauthnCredentials.length === 0) {
      mfaSettings.webauthnEnabled = false;
    }

    await this.mfaRepository.save(mfaSettings);

    console.log("🗑️ WebAuthn credential deleted:", credentialId);
  }

  /**
   * Cleanup expired challenges
   */
  private cleanupExpiredChallenges(): void {
    const now = new Date();
    let cleaned = 0;

    for (const [key, entry] of this.challenges.entries()) {
      if (entry.expiresAt < now) {
        this.challenges.delete(key);
        cleaned++;
      }
    }

    if (cleaned > 0) {
      console.log(`🧹 Cleaned up ${cleaned} expired WebAuthn challenges`);
    }
  }
}

import { JwtAuthGuard } from "@/common/guards";
import { OAuthClientService } from "./services/oauth-client.service";
import { OAuthTokenService } from "./services/oauth-token.service";
import { OAuthConsentService } from "./services/oauth-consent.service";
import {
  AuthorizeRequestDto,
  TokenRequestDto,
  TokenResponseDto,
  TokenErrorResponseDto,
  UserInfoResponseDto,
  RevokeTokenRequestDto,
  IntrospectTokenRequestDto,
  IntrospectTokenResponseDto,

  UpdateOAuthClientDto,
  OAuthClientResponseDto,
  CreateClientResponseDto,
  OpenIDConfigurationDto,
  JWKSResponseDto,
} from "./dto";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";

@ApiTags("OAuth2/OIDC")
@Controller("oauth")
export class OAuthController {
  constructor(
    private clientService: OAuthClientService,
    private tokenService: OAuthTokenService,
    private consentService: OAuthConsentService,
    private configService: ConfigService,
  ) {}

  // ============================================================
  // AUTHORIZATION ENDPOINT
  // ============================================================

  @Get("authorize")
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "OAuth2 Authorization Endpoint",
    description:
      "Initiate OAuth2 authorization code flow. User must be logged in.",
  })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "client_id", required: true })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "redirect_uri", required: true })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "response_type", required: true, enum: ["code"] })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "scope", required: true })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "state", required: false })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "nonce", required: false })
  @ApiQuery({ name: "code_challenge", required: false })
  @ApiQuery({
    name: "code_challenge_method",
    required: false,
    enum: ["S256", "plain"],
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 302,
    description: "Redirects to redirect_uri with code and state",
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: "Invalid request parameters",
  })
  async authorize(
    @Query() query: AuthorizeRequestDto,
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    // TODO: Check if user is logged in
    // For now, assume user is authenticated and we have userId
    const userId = (req.user as any)?.userId;

    if (!userId) {
      // Redirect to login with return URL
      const loginUrl = `/auth/login?return_url=${encodeURIComponent(req.url)}`;
      return res.redirect(loginUrl);
    }

    // Validate client
    const client = await this.clientService.getClient(query.client_id);

    // Validate redirect URI
    await this.clientService.validateRedirectUri(client, query.redirect_uri);

    // Validate grant type
    await this.clientService.validateGrantType(client, "authorization_code");

    // Parse scopes
    const requestedScopes = query.scope.split(" ");

    // Validate scopes
    const grantedScopes = await this.clientService.validateScopes(
      client,
      requestedScopes,
    );

    // Check PKCE requirement
    if (client.requirePkce && !query.code_challenge) {
      throw new BadRequestException("code_challenge required for this client");
    }

    // Check if consent is required
    const existingConsent = await this.consentService.getConsent(
      tenantId,
      userId,
      client.id,
    );

    const requireConsent = await this.consentService.isConsentRequired(
      client,
      existingConsent ?? undefined,
    );

    if (requireConsent) {
      // TODO: Show consent screen
      // For now, auto-grant consent
      await this.consentService.grantConsent({
        tenantId,
        clientId: client.id,
        userId,
        grantedScopes,
        rememberConsent: false,
        ipAddress: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.get("user-agent"),
      });
    }

    // Generate authorization code
    const code = await this.tokenService.createAuthorizationCode({
      tenantId,
      clientId: client.id,
      userId,
      redirectUri: query.redirect_uri,
      scope: grantedScopes.join(" "),
      state: query.state,
      nonce: query.nonce,
      codeChallenge: query.code_challenge,
      codeChallengeMethod: query.code_challenge_method,
      ipAddress: req.ip,
      userAgent: req.get("user-agent"),
    });

    // Build redirect URL
    const redirectUrl = new URL(query.redirect_uri);
    redirectUrl.searchParams.set("code", code);
    if (query.state) {
      redirectUrl.searchParams.set("state", query.state);
    }

    // Redirect to client
    return res.redirect(redirectUrl.toString());
  }

  // ============================================================
  // TOKEN ENDPOINT
  // ============================================================

  @Post("token")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "OAuth2 Token Endpoint",
    description:
      "Exchange authorization code or refresh token for access token",
  })
  @ApiBody({ type: TokenRequestDto })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: "Token issued successfully",
    type: TokenResponseDto,
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 400,
    description: "Invalid request",
    type: TokenErrorResponseDto,
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 401,
    description: "Invalid credentials",
    type: TokenErrorResponseDto,
  })
  async token(
    @Body() body: TokenRequestDto,
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Headers("authorization") authHeader?: string,
  ): Promise<TokenResponseDto> {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    // Extract client credentials
    let clientId = body.client_id;
    let clientSecret = body.client_secret;

    // Check for Basic Auth
    if (authHeader && authHeader.startsWith("Basic ")) {
      const base64 = authHeader.slice(6);
      const decoded = Buffer.from(base64, "base64").toString("utf-8");
      const [id, secret] = decoded.split(":");
      clientId = id as string;
      clientSecret = secret;
    }

    if (!clientId) {
      throw new BadRequestException("client_id required");
    }

    // Validate client
    const client = await this.clientService.validateClient(
      clientId,
      clientSecret,
    );

    // Handle different grant types
    switch (body.grant_type) {
      case "authorization_code":
        return this.handleAuthorizationCodeGrant(
          tenantId,
          client,
          body,
          req.ip,
          req.get("user-agent"),
        );

      case "refresh_token":
        return this.handleRefreshTokenGrant(
          tenantId,
          client,
          body,
          req.ip,
          req.get("user-agent"),
        );

      case "client_credentials":
        return this.handleClientCredentialsGrant(
          tenantId,
          client,
          body,
          req.ip,
          req.get("user-agent"),
        );

      default:
        throw new BadRequestException("unsupported_grant_type");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Handle authorization code grant
   */
  private async handleAuthorizationCodeGrant(
    tenantId: string,
    client: any,
    body: TokenRequestDto,
    ipAddress?: string,
    userAgent?: string,
  ): Promise<TokenResponseDto> {
    if (!body.code) {
      throw new BadRequestException("code required");
    }

    if (!body.redirect_uri) {
      throw new BadRequestException("redirect_uri required");
    }

    // Validate and consume authorization code
    const authCode = await this.tokenService.validateAuthorizationCode(
      body.code,
      client.id,
      body.redirect_uri,
      body.code_verifier,
    );

    // Create access token
    const accessToken = await this.tokenService.createAccessToken(
      {
        tenantId,
        clientId: client.id,
        userId: authCode.userId,
        scope: authCode.scope,
        ipAddress,
        userAgent,
      },
      authCode.user,
    );

    // Create refresh token
    const refreshToken = await this.tokenService.createRefreshToken({
      tenantId,
      clientId: client.id,
      userId: authCode.userId,
      scope: authCode.scope,
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
    });

    // Create ID token (if openid scope)
    let idToken: string | undefined;
    if (authCode.scope?.includes("openid")) {
      idToken = await this.tokenService.createIDToken(
        authCode.user,
        client,
        authCode.nonce,
      );
    }

    return {
      access_token: accessToken,
      token_type: "Bearer",
      expires_in: client.accessTokenTtl,
      refresh_token: refreshToken,
      id_token: idToken,
      scope: authCode.scope,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Handle refresh token grant
   */
  private async handleRefreshTokenGrant(
    tenantId: string,
    client: any,
    body: TokenRequestDto,
    ipAddress?: string,
    userAgent?: string,
  ): Promise<TokenResponseDto> {
    if (!body.refresh_token) {
      throw new BadRequestException("refresh_token required");
    }

    // Validate refresh token
    const refreshToken = await this.tokenService.validateRefreshToken(
      body.refresh_token,
    );

    // Verify client matches
    if (refreshToken.clientId !== client.id) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("client_mismatch");
    }

    // Rotate refresh token
    const newRefreshToken =
      await this.tokenService.rotateRefreshToken(refreshToken);

    // Create new access token
    const accessToken = await this.tokenService.createAccessToken(
      {
        tenantId,
        clientId: client.id,
        userId: refreshToken.userId,
        scope: refreshToken.scope,
        ipAddress,
        userAgent,
      },
      refreshToken.user,
    );

    return {
      access_token: accessToken,
      token_type: "Bearer",
      expires_in: client.accessTokenTtl,
      refresh_token: newRefreshToken,
      scope: refreshToken.scope,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Handle client credentials grant (M2M)
   */
  private async handleClientCredentialsGrant(
    tenantId: string,
    client: any,
    body: TokenRequestDto,
    ipAddress?: string,
    userAgent?: string,
  ): Promise<TokenResponseDto> {
    // Client must be confidential
    if (client.clientType !== "confidential") {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        "client_credentials requires confidential client",
      );
    }

    // Validate scopes
    const requestedScopes = body.scope ? body.scope.split(" ") : [];
    const grantedScopes = await this.clientService.validateScopes(
      client,
      requestedScopes,
    );

    // Create access token (no user)
    const accessToken = await this.tokenService.createAccessToken({
      tenantId,
      clientId: client.id,
      userId: undefined, // M2M token
      scope: grantedScopes.join(" "),
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
    });

    return {
      access_token: accessToken,
      token_type: "Bearer",
      expires_in: client.accessTokenTtl,
      scope: grantedScopes.join(" "),
    };
  }

    return {

      email: user.email,
      email_verified: true, // TODO: Get from user entity
      name: user.name,
      given_name: user.given_name,
      family_name: user.family_name,
      picture: user.picture,
      updated_at: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
    };
  }

  @Post("revoke")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "OAuth2 Token Revocation",
    description: "Revoke an access or refresh token",
  })
  @ApiBody({ type: RevokeTokenRequestDto })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: "Token revoked (always returns 200 even if token invalid)",
  })
  async revoke(
    @Body() body: RevokeTokenRequestDto,
    @Headers("authorization") authHeader?: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    // TODO: Validate client credentials from Authorization header

    // Always return 200 per spec (don't leak token validity)
    try {
      if (body.token_type_hint === "refresh_token") {
        await this.tokenService.revokeRefreshToken(body.token);
      } else {
        await this.tokenService.revokeAccessToken(body.token);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      // Silently fail per spec
    }
  }

  @Get(".well-known/openid-configuration")

    const baseUrl = this.configService.get(

    );

    return {
      issuer: baseUrl,
      authorization_endpoint: `${baseUrl}/oauth/authorize`,
      token_endpoint: `${baseUrl}/oauth/token`,
      userinfo_endpoint: `${baseUrl}/oauth/userinfo`,
      jwks_uri: `${baseUrl}/oauth/jwks`,
      revocation_endpoint: `${baseUrl}/oauth/revoke`,
      introspection_endpoint: `${baseUrl}/oauth/introspect`,
      response_types_supported: ["code"],
      grant_types_supported: [
        "authorization_code",
        "refresh_token",
        "client_credentials",
      ],
      subject_types_supported: ["public"],
      id_token_signing_alg_values_supported: ["RS256"],
      scopes_supported: [
        "openid",
        "profile",
        "email",
        "phone",
        "address",
        "offline_access",
      ],
      token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported: [
        "client_secret_basic",
        "client_secret_post",
        "none",
      ],
      code_challenge_methods_supported: ["S256", "plain"],
      claims_supported: [
        "sub",
        "email",
        "email_verified",
        "name",
        "given_name",
        "family_name",
        "picture",
      ],
    };
  }

  // CLIENT MANAGEMENT (Protected with RBAC)

  /**
   * Create OAuth Client
   * Requires: clients:write permission
   * Only developers and admins can create OAuth clients
   */
  @Post("clients")
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("clients:write")
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Create OAuth Client (Requires: clients:write)",
    description: "Register a new OAuth2 client application",
  })
  @ApiBody({ type: CreateOAuthClientDto })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 201,
    description: "Client created",
    type: CreateClientResponseDto,
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: "Forbidden - missing permissions" })
  async createClient(
    @Body() dto: CreateOAuthClientDto,
    @Req() req: Request,
  ): Promise<CreateClientResponseDto> {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const userId = (req.user as any).sub;

    const { client, clientSecret } = await this.clientService.createClient({
      tenantId,
      ...dto,
      createdBy: userId,
    });

    return {
      ...client,
      clientSecret, // Only shown once!
    } as any;
  }

  /**
   * List OAuth Clients
   * Requires: clients:read permission
   */
  @Get("clients")
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("clients:read")
  @ApiBearerAuth()
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "List OAuth Clients (Requires: clients:read)",
    description: "Get all OAuth2 clients for current tenant",
  })
  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,
    description: "List of clients",
    type: [OAuthClientResponseDto],
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: "Forbidden - missing permissions" })
  async listClients(@Req() req: Request) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    const { clients } = await this.clientService.listClients(tenantId, {
      isActive: true,
    });

    return clients;
  }

   * Get OAuth Client

    description: "Generate a new client secret",

  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Secret rotated" })

  // ============================================================

  /*
  These endpoints remain public/unprotected:

  - GET /oauth/authorize - OAuth flow start (requires user login redirect)
  - POST /oauth/token - Token exchange (validated by client credentials)
  - GET /oauth/userinfo - Protected by Bearer token
  - POST /oauth/revoke - Token revocation
  - POST /oauth/introspect - Token introspection
  - GET /.well-known/openid-configuration - OIDC discovery
  - GET /oauth/jwks - Public keys

  These are part of the OAuth2/OIDC spec and must remain accessible
  for OAuth clients to function properly.
  */

    OAuthClientService,
    OAuthTokenService,
    OAuthConsentService,

    RbacService,
  ],
  exports: [OAuthClientService, OAuthTokenService, OAuthConsentService],
})
export class OAuthModule {}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { OAuthClient } from "@repo/database";
import { PasswordService } from "@repo/security";
import * as crypto from "crypto";

export interface CreateClientDto {
  tenantId: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  logoUrl?: string;
  websiteUrl?: string;
  privacyPolicyUrl?: string;
  termsOfServiceUrl?: string;
  clientType: "confidential" | "public";
  grantTypes: string[];
  redirectUris: string[];
  postLogoutRedirectUris?: string[];
  allowedOrigins?: string[];
  allowedScopes?: string[];
  defaultScopes?: string[];
  requirePkce?: boolean;
  requireConsent?: boolean;
  isFirstParty?: boolean;
  accessTokenTtl?: number;
  refreshTokenTtl?: number;
  idTokenTtl?: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  createdBy?: string;
}

export interface UpdateClientDto {
  name?: string;
  description?: string;
  logoUrl?: string;
  websiteUrl?: string;
  privacyPolicyUrl?: string;
  termsOfServiceUrl?: string;
  grantTypes?: string[];
  redirectUris?: string[];
  postLogoutRedirectUris?: string[];
  allowedOrigins?: string[];
  allowedScopes?: string[];
  defaultScopes?: string[];
  requirePkce?: boolean;
  requireConsent?: boolean;
  isActive?: boolean;
  accessTokenTtl?: number;
  refreshTokenTtl?: number;
  idTokenTtl?: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

@Injectable()
export class OAuthClientService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(OAuthClient)
    private clientRepository: Repository<OAuthClient>,
    private passwordService: PasswordService,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Create new OAuth client
   * Returns client with plaintext secret (only time it's visible)
   */
  async createClient(data: CreateClientDto): Promise<{
    client: OAuthClient;
    clientSecret?: string;
  }> {
    // Validate grant types
    const validGrantTypes = [
      "authorization_code",
      "refresh_token",
      "client_credentials",
      "password", // Optional, legacy
    ];

    const invalidGrants = data.grantTypes.filter(
      (g) => !validGrantTypes.includes(g),
    );
    if (invalidGrants.length > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Invalid grant types: ${invalidGrants.join(", ")}`,
      );
    }

    // Validate redirect URIs for authorization_code grant
    if (data.grantTypes.includes("authorization_code")) {
      if (!data.redirectUris || data.redirectUris.length === 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          "redirect_uris required for authorization_code grant",
        );
      }

      // Validate URIs
      for (const uri of data.redirectUris) {
        try {
          const url = new URL(uri);
          // Allow localhost for development
          const isLocalhost =
            url.hostname === "localhost" || url.hostname === "127.0.0.1";
          const isHttps = url.protocol === "https:";

          if (!isHttps && !isLocalhost) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
              `Redirect URI must use HTTPS: ${uri}`,
            );
          }
        } catch (error) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid redirect URI: ${uri}`);
        }
      }
    }

    // Generate client ID
    const clientId = `${data.isFirstParty ? "fortknox" : "client"}_${crypto.randomBytes(16).toString("hex")}`;

    // Generate client secret (for confidential clients)
    let clientSecret: string | undefined;
    let clientSecretHash: string | undefined;

    if (data.clientType === "confidential") {
      clientSecret = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
      clientSecretHash = await PasswordService.hash(clientSecret);
    }

    // Public clients MUST use PKCE
    const requirePkce =
      data.clientType === "public" ? true : (data.requirePkce ?? false);

    // Third-party clients MUST show consent
    const requireConsent = data.isFirstParty
      ? false
      : (data.requireConsent ?? true);

    // Create client
    const client = await this.clientRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      clientId,
      clientSecretHash,
      clientType: data.clientType,
      name: data.name,
      description: data.description,
      logoUrl: data.logoUrl,
      websiteUrl: data.websiteUrl,
      privacyPolicyUrl: data.privacyPolicyUrl,
      termsOfServiceUrl: data.termsOfServiceUrl,
      grantTypes: data.grantTypes,
      redirectUris: data.redirectUris,
      postLogoutRedirectUris: data.postLogoutRedirectUris,
      allowedOrigins: data.allowedOrigins,
      allowedScopes: data.allowedScopes,
      defaultScopes: data.defaultScopes,
      requirePkce,
      requireConsent,
      isFirstParty: data.isFirstParty ?? false,
      accessTokenTtl: data.accessTokenTtl ?? 900, // 15 min
      refreshTokenTtl: data.refreshTokenTtl ?? 604800, // 7 days
      idTokenTtl: data.idTokenTtl ?? 3600, // 1 hour
      authorizationCodeTtl: 600, // 10 minutes
      metadata: data.metadata,
      createdBy: data.createdBy,
    });

    console.log(`✅ Created OAuth client: ${client.clientId} (${client.name})`);

    return {
      client,
      clientSecret, // Return plaintext secret only on creation
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get client by client_id
   */
  async getClient(clientId: string): Promise<OAuthClient> {
    const client = await this.clientRepository.findOne({
      where: { clientId, isActive: true },
    });

    if (!client) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Client not found");
    }

    return client;
  }

  /**
   * Get client with secret hash (for validation)
   */
  async getClientWithSecret(clientId: string): Promise<OAuthClient> {
    const client = await this.clientRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("client")
      .where("client.clientId = :clientId", { clientId })
      .andWhere("client.isActive = :isActive", { isActive: true })
      .addSelect("client.clientSecretHash")
      .getOne();

    if (!client) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Client not found");
    }

    return client;
  }

  /**
   * Validate client credentials
   */
  async validateClient(
    clientId: string,
    clientSecret?: string,
  ): Promise<OAuthClient> {
    const client = await this.getClientWithSecret(clientId);

    // Public clients don't have secrets
    if (client.clientType === "public") {
      if (clientSecret) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          "Public clients should not send client_secret",
        );
      }
      return client;
    }

    // Confidential clients must provide secret
    if (client.clientType === "confidential") {
      if (!clientSecret) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          "client_secret required for confidential clients",
        );
      }

      if (!client.clientSecretHash) {
        throw new Error("Client secret hash missing");
      }

      const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(
        client.clientSecretHash,
        clientSecret,
      );

      if (!isValid) {
        throw new BadRequestException("Invalid client credentials");
      }

      return client;
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid client type");
  }

  /**
   * Validate redirect URI
   */
  async validateRedirectUri(
    client: OAuthClient,
    redirectUri: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!client.redirectUris.includes(redirectUri)) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid redirect_uri");
    }

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Validate grant type
   */
  async validateGrantType(
    client: OAuthClient,
    grantType: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!client.grantTypes.includes(grantType)) {
      throw new BadRequestException(`Grant type not allowed: ${grantType}`);
    }

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Validate scopes
   */
  async validateScopes(
    client: OAuthClient,
    requestedScopes: string[],
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    // If no scopes allowed, use defaults or return empty
    if (!client.allowedScopes || client.allowedScopes.length === 0) {
      return client.defaultScopes || [];
    }

    // Filter requested scopes to only allowed ones
    const allowedScopes = requestedScopes.filter((scope) =>
      client.allowedScopes!.includes(scope),
    );

    // If no valid scopes, use defaults
    if (allowedScopes.length === 0 && client.defaultScopes) {
      return client.defaultScopes;
    }

    return allowedScopes;
  }

  /**
   * Update client
   */
  async updateClient(
    clientId: string,
    data: UpdateClientDto,
  ): Promise<OAuthClient> {
    const client = await this.getClient(clientId);

    // Validate redirect URIs if updated
    if (data.redirectUris) {
      for (const uri of data.redirectUris) {
        try {
          const url = new URL(uri);
          const isLocalhost =
            url.hostname === "localhost" || url.hostname === "127.0.0.1";
          const isHttps = url.protocol === "https:";

          if (!isHttps && !isLocalhost) {
            throw new BadRequestException(
              `Redirect URI must use HTTPS: ${uri}`,
            );
          }
        } catch (error) {
          throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid redirect URI: ${uri}`);
        }
      }
    }

    // Update fields
    Object.assign(client, data);

    await this.clientRepository.save(client);

    console.log(`✅ Updated OAuth client: ${client.clientId}`);

    return client;
  }

  /**
   * Rotate client secret
   */
  async rotateClientSecret(clientId: string): Promise<{
    client: OAuthClient;
    clientSecret: string;
  }> {
    const client = await this.getClient(clientId);

    if (client.clientType !== "confidential") {
      throw new BadRequestException("Only confidential clients have secrets");
    }

    // Generate new secret
    const clientSecret = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
    const clientSecretHash = await PasswordService.hash(clientSecret);

    // Update client
    client.clientSecretHash = clientSecretHash;
    await this.clientRepository.save(client);

    console.log(`🔄 Rotated client secret: ${client.clientId}`);

    return {
      client,
      clientSecret, // Return plaintext secret only once
    };
  }

  /**
   * Delete client
   */
  async deleteClient(clientId: string): Promise<void> {
    const client = await this.getClient(clientId);

    // Soft delete by marking inactive
    client.isActive = false;
    await this.clientRepository.save(client);

    console.log(`🗑️  Deleted OAuth client: ${client.clientId}`);
  }

  /**
   * List clients for tenant
   */
  async listClients(
    tenantId: string,
    options?: {
      isActive?: boolean;
      isFirstParty?: boolean;
      limit?: number;
      offset?: number;
    },
  ): Promise<{ clients: OAuthClient[]; total: number }> {
    const query = this.clientRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("client")
      .where("client.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId });

    if (options?.isActive !== undefined) {
      query.andWhere("client.isActive = :isActive", {
        isActive: options.isActive,
      });
    }

    if (options?.isFirstParty !== undefined) {
      query.andWhere("client.isFirstParty = :isFirstParty", {
        isFirstParty: options.isFirstParty,
      });
    }

    query.orderBy("client.createdAt", "DESC");

    if (options?.limit) {
      query.take(options.limit);
    }

    if (options?.offset) {
      query.skip(options.offset);
    }

    const [clients, total] = await query.getManyAndCount();

    return { clients, total };
  }
}

// apps/auth-service/src/modules/oauth/services/oauth-consent.service.ts

import { Injectable, NotFoundException } from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, IsNull } from "typeorm";
import { OAuthConsent, OAuthClient, User } from "@repo/database";

export interface GrantConsentDto {
  tenantId: string;
  clientId: string;
  userId: string;
  grantedScopes: string[];
  rememberConsent?: boolean;
  expiresInDays?: number;
  ipAddress?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class OAuthConsentService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(OAuthConsent)
    private consentRepository: Repository<OAuthConsent>,
    @InjectRepository(OAuthClient)
    private clientRepository: Repository<OAuthClient>,
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Check if user has granted consent to client for requested scopes
   */
  async hasConsent(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    clientId: string,
    requestedScopes: string[],
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const consent = await this.getConsent(tenantId, userId, clientId);

    if (!consent) {
      return false;
    }

    // Check if consent has all requested scopes
    return consent.hasAllScopes(requestedScopes);
  }

  /**
   * Get active consent for user-client pair
   */
  async getConsent(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    clientId: string,
  ): Promise<OAuthConsent | null> {
    const consent = await this.consentRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        userId,
        clientId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      relations: ["client", "user"],
    });

    if (!consent) {
      return null;
    }

    // Check if expired
    if (consent.isExpired) {
      return null;
    }

    return consent;
  }

  /**
   * Grant consent
   */
  async grantConsent(data: GrantConsentDto): Promise<OAuthConsent> {
    // Validate client exists
    const client = await this.clientRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: data.clientId },
    });

    if (!client) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Client not found");
    }

    // Validate user exists
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: data.userId },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    // Calculate expiry
    let expiresAt: Date | undefined;
    if (data.expiresInDays && !data.rememberConsent) {
      expiresAt = new Date(
        Date.now() + data.expiresInDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
      );
    }
    // If rememberConsent = true, expiresAt = null (permanent)

    // Check if consent already exists
    const existingConsent = await this.consentRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId: data.tenantId,
        userId: data.userId,
        clientId: data.clientId,
      },
    });

    if (existingConsent) {
      // Update existing consent
      existingConsent.grantedScopes = data.grantedScopes;
      existingConsent.rememberConsent = data.rememberConsent || false;
      existingConsent.expiresAt = expiresAt;
      existingConsent.revokedAt = undefined; // Un-revoke if previously revoked
      existingConsent.revokedReason = undefined;
      existingConsent.ipAddress = data.ipAddress;
      existingConsent.userAgent = data.userAgent;

      await this.consentRepository.save(existingConsent);

      console.log(
        `✅ Updated consent: user ${data.userId} → client ${client.clientId}`,
      );

      return existingConsent;
    }

    // Create new consent
    const consent = await this.consentRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      clientId: data.clientId,
      userId: data.userId,
      grantedScopes: data.grantedScopes,
      rememberConsent: data.rememberConsent || false,
      expiresAt,
      ipAddress: data.ipAddress,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
    });

    console.log(
      `✅ Granted consent: user ${data.userId} → client ${client.clientId}`,
    );

    return consent;
  }

  /**
   * Revoke consent
   */
  async revokeConsent(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    clientId: string,
    reason: string = "user_revoked",
  ): Promise<void> {
    const consent = await this.consentRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        userId,
        clientId,
      },
    });

    if (!consent) {
      return; // Already doesn't exist
    }

    consent.revokedAt = new Date();
    consent.revokedReason = reason;

    await this.consentRepository.save(consent);

    console.log(`🔒 Revoked consent: user ${userId} → client ${clientId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all consents for user
   */
  async revokeAllUserConsents(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    reason: string = "user_revoked_all",
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.consentRepository.update(
      {
        tenantId,
        userId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    console.log(`🔒 Revoked all consents for user ${userId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all consents for client
   */
  async revokeAllClientConsents(
    tenantId: string,
    clientId: string,
    reason: string = "client_deactivated",
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.consentRepository.update(
      {
        tenantId,
        clientId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    console.log(`🔒 Revoked all consents for client ${clientId}`);
  }

  /**
   * List user consents
   */
  async listUserConsents(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    includeRevoked: boolean = false,
  ): Promise<OAuthConsent[]> {
    const query = this.consentRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("consent")
      .leftJoinAndSelect("consent.client", "client")
      .where("consent.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .andWhere("consent.userId = :userId", { userId });

    if (!includeRevoked) {
      query.andWhere("consent.revokedAt IS NULL");
    }

    query.orderBy("consent.createdAt", "DESC");

    return query.getMany();
  }

  /**
   * List client consents
   */
  async listClientConsents(
    tenantId: string,
    clientId: string,
    includeRevoked: boolean = false,
  ): Promise<OAuthConsent[]> {
    const query = this.consentRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("consent")
      .leftJoinAndSelect("consent.user", "user")
      .where("consent.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .andWhere("consent.clientId = :clientId", { clientId });

    if (!includeRevoked) {
      query.andWhere("consent.revokedAt IS NULL");
    }

    query.orderBy("consent.createdAt", "DESC");

    return query.getMany();
  }

  /**
   * Get consent statistics for client
   */
  async getClientConsentStats(
    tenantId: string,
    clientId: string,
  ): Promise<{
    total: number;
    active: number;
    revoked: number;
    expired: number;
  }> {
    const allConsents = await this.consentRepository.find({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        clientId,
      },
    });

    const stats = {
      total: allConsents.length,
      active: 0,
      revoked: 0,
      expired: 0,
    };

    for (const consent of allConsents) {
      if (consent.revokedAt) {
        stats.revoked++;
      } else if (consent.isExpired) {
        stats.expired++;
      } else {
        stats.active++;
      }
    }

    return stats;
  }

  /**
   * Clean up expired consents
   */
  async cleanupExpiredConsents(): Promise<number> {
    const now = new Date();

    // Soft-delete expired consents (mark as revoked)
    const result = await this.consentRepository
      .createQueryBuilder()
      .update(OAuthConsent)
      .set({
        revokedAt: now,
        revokedReason: "expired",
      })
      .where("expiresAt IS NOT NULL")
      .andWhere("expiresAt < :now", { now })
      .andWhere("revokedAt IS NULL")
      .execute();

    const count = result.affected || 0;

    if (count > 0) {
      console.log(`🧹 Cleaned up ${count} expired consents`);
    }

    return count;
  }

  /**
   * Check if consent is required for client
   */
  async isConsentRequired(
    client: OAuthClient,
    existingConsent?: OAuthConsent,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    // First-party clients don't need consent
    if (client.isFirstParty) {
      return false;
    }

    // If client doesn't require consent
    if (!client.requireConsent) {
      return false;
    }

    // If user already has valid consent
    if (existingConsent && existingConsent.isValid) {
      return false;
    }

    // Otherwise, consent is required
    return true;
  }
}

import { Injectable, Logger, UnauthorizedException } from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, IsNull } from "typeorm";
import { OAuthRefreshToken } from "@repo/database";
import * as crypto from "crypto";
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";

/**
 * OAuthRefreshTokenService
 *
 * Handles refresh token storage, rotation, and reuse detection
 *
 * Security Features:
 * - Token rotation (new token on each use)
 * - Reuse detection (if old token used, revoke family)
 * - Family tracking (all tokens in rotation chain)
 * - Automatic expiration
 */
@Injectable()
export class OAuthRefreshTokenService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(OAuthRefreshTokenService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(OAuthRefreshToken)
    private readonly refreshTokenRepository: Repository<OAuthRefreshToken>,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Create a new refresh token
   */
  async createRefreshToken(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    userId: string;
    sessionId: string;
    clientId?: string;
    scope?: string;
    ipAddress?: string;
    userAgent?: string;
    deviceId?: string;
    expiresInDays?: number;
  }): Promise<{ token: string; entity: OAuthRefreshToken }> {
    const { expiresInDays = 30, ...rest } = params;

    // Generate random token
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
    const tokenHash = this.hashToken(token);

    // Generate new family
    const familyId = uuidv4();

    // Calculate expiry
    const expiresAt = new Date();
    expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + expiresInDays);

    // Store in database
    const entity = await this.refreshTokenRepository.save({
      ...rest,
      tokenHash,
      familyId,
      expiresAt,
    });

    this.logger.log(`Created refresh token for user ${params.userId}`, {
      tokenId: entity.id,
      familyId,
      expiresAt,
    });

    return { token, entity };
  }

  /**
   * Validate and rotate refresh token
   *
   * Returns new token and handles reuse detection
   */
  async rotateRefreshToken(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    token: string;
    ipAddress?: string;
    userAgent?: string;
  }): Promise<{ accessTokenPayload: any; newToken: string }> {
    const { tenantId, token, ipAddress, userAgent } = params;

    // Hash incoming token
    const tokenHash = this.hashToken(token);

    // Find token in database
    const storedToken = await this.refreshTokenRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        tokenHash,
      },
      relations: ["user", "session"],
    });

    if (!storedToken) {
      this.logger.warn("Refresh token not found", { tenantId });
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid refresh token");
    }

    // ============================================================
    // REUSE DETECTION
    // ============================================================
    if (storedToken.usedAt) {
      this.logger.error("🚨 REFRESH TOKEN REUSE DETECTED", {
        tokenId: storedToken.id,
        userId: storedToken.userId,
        familyId: storedToken.familyId,
        originalUse: storedToken.usedAt,
        newAttempt: new Date(),
      });

      // SECURITY: Revoke entire token family
      await this.revokeTokenFamily(storedToken.familyId, tenantId);

      throw new UnauthorizedException(
        "Token reuse detected. All sessions in this family have been revoked.",
      );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // VALIDATION
    // ============================================================
    if (storedToken.revokedAt) {
      this.logger.warn("Refresh token revoked", {
        tokenId: storedToken.id,
        revokedAt: storedToken.revokedAt,
        reason: storedToken.revokedReason,
      });
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Refresh token has been revoked");
    }

    if (storedToken.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      this.logger.warn("Refresh token expired", {
        tokenId: storedToken.id,
        expiresAt: storedToken.expiresAt,
      });
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Refresh token has expired");
    }

    // Check session is still valid
    if (!storedToken.session || storedToken.session.revokedAt) {
      this.logger.warn("Session revoked or not found", {
        sessionId: storedToken.sessionId,
      });
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Session no longer valid");
    }

    // ============================================================
    // ROTATION
    // ============================================================

    // Mark current token as USED
    storedToken.usedAt = new Date();
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.save(storedToken);

    this.logger.debug("Marked refresh token as used", {
      tokenId: storedToken.id,
    });

    // Generate NEW refresh token (same family)
    const newToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
    const newTokenHash = this.hashToken(newToken);

    // Store new token
    const newRefreshToken = await this.refreshTokenRepository.save({
      tenantId,
      userId: storedToken.userId,
      sessionId: storedToken.sessionId,
      clientId: storedToken.clientId,
      scope: storedToken.scope,
      tokenHash: newTokenHash,
      familyId: storedToken.familyId, // SAME family
      parentTokenId: storedToken.id, // Link to parent
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 30 days
      ipAddress,
      userAgent,
    });

    this.logger.log("Rotated refresh token", {
      oldTokenId: storedToken.id,
      newTokenId: newRefreshToken.id,
      familyId: storedToken.familyId,
    });

    // Return payload for new access token
    const accessTokenPayload = {
      sub: storedToken.userId,
      email: storedToken.user.email,
      tenantId: storedToken.tenantId,
      sessionId: storedToken.sessionId,
      scope: storedToken.scope,
    };

    return {
      accessTokenPayload,
      newToken,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Revoke a single refresh token
   */
  async revokeToken(
    tokenHash: string,
    tenantId: string,
    reason: string = "manual_revocation",
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      { tokenHash, tenantId },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    this.logger.log("Revoked refresh token", { tokenHash, reason });
  }

  /**
   * Revoke entire token family (for reuse detection)
   */
  async revokeTokenFamily(familyId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      { familyId, tenantId },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "family_revoked_reuse_detection",
      },
    );

    this.logger.warn("🔥 Revoked entire token family", {
      familyId,
      tenantId,
      tokensRevoked: result.affected,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all tokens for a user
   */
  async revokeAllUserTokens(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    reason: string = "user_logout_all",
  ): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      { userId, tenantId, revokedAt: IsNull() },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    this.logger.log("Revoked all user tokens", {
      userId,
      tenantId,
      tokensRevoked: result.affected,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all tokens for a session
   */
  async revokeSessionTokens(
    sessionId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    reason: string = "session_logout",
  ): Promise<void> {
    const result = await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      { sessionId, tenantId, revokedAt: IsNull() },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    this.logger.log("Revoked session tokens", {
      sessionId,
      tenantId,
      tokensRevoked: result.affected,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get all active tokens for a user
   */
  async getUserTokens(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<OAuthRefreshToken[]> {
    return this.refreshTokenRepository.find({
      where: {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      order: {
        createdAt: "DESC",
      },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Clean up expired tokens (run as cron job)
   */
  async cleanupExpiredTokens(tenantId?: string): Promise<number> {
    const query = this.refreshTokenRepository.createQueryBuilder("token");

    query.where("token.expiresAt < :now", { now: new Date() });

    if (tenantId) {
      query.andWhere("token.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId });
    }

    const result = await query.delete().execute();

    this.logger.log("Cleaned up expired tokens", {
      tenantId,
      tokensDeleted: result.affected,
    });

    return result.affected || 0;
  }

  /**
   * Hash a token using SHA-256
   */
  private hashToken(token: string): string {
    return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  UnauthorizedException,
  BadRequestException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, IsNull, LessThan } from "typeorm";
import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
import { JwtService } from "@nestjs/jwt";
import {
  OAuthAuthorizationCode,
  OAuthAccessToken,
  OAuthRefreshToken,
  OAuthClient,
  User,
} from "@repo/database";
import * as crypto from "crypto";
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";

export interface CreateAuthorizationCodeDto {
  tenantId: string;
  clientId: string;
  userId: string;
  redirectUri: string;
  scope?: string;
  state?: string;
  nonce?: string;
  codeChallenge?: string;
  codeChallengeMethod?: "S256" | "plain";
  ipAddress?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
}

export interface CreateAccessTokenDto {
  tenantId: string;
  clientId: string;
  userId?: string; // NULL for client_credentials
  sessionId?: string;
  scope?: string;
  audience?: string;
  ipAddress?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
}

export interface CreateRefreshTokenDto {
  tenantId: string;
  clientId: string;
  userId: string;
  accessTokenId?: string;
  familyId?: string; // For rotation
  parentTokenId?: string; // For rotation
  scope?: string;
  deviceId?: string;
  ipAddress?: string;
  userAgent?: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class OAuthTokenService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(OAuthAuthorizationCode)
    private authCodeRepository: Repository<OAuthAuthorizationCode>,
    @InjectRepository(OAuthAccessToken)
    private accessTokenRepository: Repository<OAuthAccessToken>,
    @InjectRepository(OAuthRefreshToken)
    private refreshTokenRepository: Repository<OAuthRefreshToken>,
    @InjectRepository(OAuthClient)
    private clientRepository: Repository<OAuthClient>,
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
    private jwtService: JwtService,
    private configService: ConfigService,
  ) {}

  // ============================================================
  // AUTHORIZATION CODES
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Create authorization code
   * Returns plaintext code (opaque, random string)
   */
  async createAuthorizationCode(
    data: CreateAuthorizationCodeDto,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const client = await this.clientRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: data.clientId },
    });

    if (!client) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid client");
    }

    // Generate random code
    const code = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
    const codeHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(code).digest("hex");

    // Calculate expiry
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + client.authorizationCodeTtl * 1000);

    // Save code
    await this.authCodeRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      clientId: data.clientId,
      userId: data.userId,
      codeHash,
      redirectUri: data.redirectUri,
      scope: data.scope,
      state: data.state,
      nonce: data.nonce,
      codeChallenge: data.codeChallenge,
      codeChallengeMethod: data.codeChallengeMethod,
      expiresAt,
      ipAddress: data.ipAddress,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
    });

    console.log(`✅ Created authorization code for user ${data.userId}`);

    return code; // Return plaintext code
  }

  /**
   * Validate and consume authorization code
   */
  async validateAuthorizationCode(
    code: string,
    clientId: string,
    redirectUri: string,
    codeVerifier?: string,
  ): Promise<OAuthAuthorizationCode> {
    const codeHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(code).digest("hex");

    const authCode = await this.authCodeRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        codeHash,
        clientId,
        usedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      relations: ["client", "user"],
    });

    if (!authCode) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid authorization code");
    }

    // Check expiry
    if (authCode.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Authorization code expired");
    }

    // Check redirect URI matches
    if (authCode.redirectUri !== redirectUri) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Redirect URI mismatch");
    }

    // Validate PKCE if present
    if (authCode.codeChallenge) {
      if (!codeVerifier) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException("code_verifier required for PKCE");
      }

      const isValid = await this.validatePKCE(
        codeVerifier,
        authCode.codeChallenge,
        authCode.codeChallengeMethod || "S256",
      );

      if (!isValid) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid code_verifier");
      }
    }

    // Mark as used
    authCode.usedAt = new Date();
    await this.authCodeRepository.save(authCode);

    console.log(`✅ Consumed authorization code for user ${authCode.userId}`);

    return authCode;
  }

  /**
   * Validate PKCE code verifier
   */
  async validatePKCE(
    codeVerifier: string,
    codeChallenge: string,
    method: "S256" | "plain",
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    let computedChallenge: string;

    if (method === "S256") {
      computedChallenge = crypto
        .createHash("sha256")
        .update(codeVerifier)
        .digest("base64url");
    } else if (method === "plain") {
      computedChallenge = codeVerifier;
    } else {
      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid code_challenge_method");
    }

    return computedChallenge === codeChallenge;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ACCESS TOKENS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Create access token (JWT)
   */
  async createAccessToken(
    data: CreateAccessTokenDto,
    user?: User,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const client = await this.clientRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: data.clientId },
    });

    if (!client) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid client");
    }

    // Generate JTI (JWT ID)
    const jti = uuidv4();
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(jti).digest("hex");

    // Calculate expiry
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + client.accessTokenTtl * 1000);
    const exp = Math.floor(expiresAt.getTime() / 1000);
    const iat = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

    // Build JWT payload
    const payload: any = {
      iss: this.configService.get("JWT_ISSUER", "https://auth.fortknox.io"),
      sub: data.userId || data.clientId, // User ID or client ID for M2M
      aud: data.audience || data.clientId,
      exp,
      iat,
      jti,
      client_id: client.clientId,
      tenant_id: data.tenantId,
      token_type: "access_token",
    };

    // Add scope if present
    if (data.scope) {
      payload.scope = data.scope;
    }

    // Add session ID if present
    if (data.sessionId) {
      payload.session_id = data.sessionId;
    }

    // Add user claims for user tokens
    if (user) {
      payload.email = user.email;
      payload.email_verified = user.emailVerified;
    }

    // Sign JWT
    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(payload, {
      secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
      expiresIn: client.accessTokenTtl,
    });

    // Store token record (for revocation tracking)
    await this.accessTokenRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      clientId: data.clientId,
      userId: data.userId,
      sessionId: data.sessionId,
      tokenHash,
      scope: data.scope,
      audience: data.audience,
      expiresAt,
      ipAddress: data.ipAddress,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
    });

    console.log(`✅ Created access token for ${data.userId || "M2M"}`);

    return accessToken;
  }

  /**
   * Validate access token
   */
  async validateAccessToken(token: string): Promise<OAuthAccessToken> {
    // Verify JWT signature
    let payload: any;
    try {
      payload = this.jwtService.verify(token, {
        secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid access token");
    }

    // Look up token in database (for revocation check)
    const jti = payload.jti;
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(jti).digest("hex");

    const accessToken = await this.accessTokenRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tokenHash,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
    });

    if (!accessToken) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Access token revoked or invalid");
    }

    // Check expiry
    if (accessToken.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Access token expired");
    }

    // Update last used
    accessToken.lastUsedAt = new Date();
    accessToken.useCount += 1;
    await this.accessTokenRepository.save(accessToken);

    return accessToken;
  }

  /**
   * Revoke access token
   */
  async revokeAccessToken(
    token: string,
    reason: string = "user_revoked",
  ): Promise<void> {
    // Decode without verifying (to get JTI)
    const payload = this.jwtService.decode(token) as any;

    if (!payload || !payload.jti) {
      return; // Invalid token, nothing to revoke
    }

    const jti = payload.jti;
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(jti).digest("hex");

    await this.accessTokenRepository.update(
      { tokenHash },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    console.log(`🔒 Revoked access token: ${reason}`);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // REFRESH TOKENS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Create refresh token (opaque)
   */
  async createRefreshToken(data: CreateRefreshTokenDto): Promise<string> {
    const client = await this.clientRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: data.clientId },
    });

    if (!client) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid client");
    }

    // Generate random token
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");

    // Generate family ID if not provided (new family)
    const familyId = data.familyId || uuidv4();

    // Calculate expiry
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + client.refreshTokenTtl * 1000);

    // Save token
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      clientId: data.clientId,
      userId: data.userId,
      accessTokenId: data.accessTokenId,
      tokenHash,
      familyId,
      parentTokenId: data.parentTokenId,
      scope: data.scope,
      expiresAt,
      deviceId: data.deviceId,
      ipAddress: data.ipAddress,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
    });

    console.log(`✅ Created refresh token for user ${data.userId}`);

    return token; // Return plaintext token
  }

  /**
   * Validate refresh token
   */
  async validateRefreshToken(token: string): Promise<OAuthRefreshToken> {
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");

    const refreshToken = await this.refreshTokenRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tokenHash,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      relations: ["client", "user"],
    });

    if (!refreshToken) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid refresh token");
    }

    // Check expiry
    if (refreshToken.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException("Refresh token expired");
    }

    // REUSE DETECTION
    if (refreshToken.usedAt) {
      // Token already used! Security breach!
      console.error("🚨 REFRESH TOKEN REUSE DETECTED", {
        tokenId: refreshToken.id,
        familyId: refreshToken.familyId,
        userId: refreshToken.userId,
      });

      // Revoke entire family
      await this.revokeRefreshTokenFamily(
        refreshToken.familyId,
        "token_reuse_detected",
      );

      throw new UnauthorizedException(
        "Token reuse detected - all sessions revoked",
      );
    }

    return refreshToken;
  }

  /**
   * Rotate refresh token (exchange old for new)
   */
  async rotateRefreshToken(oldToken: OAuthRefreshToken): Promise<string> {
    // Mark old token as used
    oldToken.usedAt = new Date();
    oldToken.revokedAt = new Date();
    oldToken.revokedReason = "rotated";
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.save(oldToken);

    // Create new token in same family
    const newToken = await this.createRefreshToken({
      tenantId: oldToken.tenantId,
      clientId: oldToken.clientId,
      userId: oldToken.userId,
      familyId: oldToken.familyId, // Same family
      parentTokenId: oldToken.id, // Track rotation chain
      scope: oldToken.scope,
      deviceId: oldToken.deviceId,
      ipAddress: oldToken.ipAddress,
      userAgent: oldToken.userAgent,
    });

    console.log(`🔄 Rotated refresh token for user ${oldToken.userId}`);

    return newToken;
  }

  /**
   * Revoke refresh token
   */
  async revokeRefreshToken(
    token: string,
    reason: string = "user_revoked",
  ): Promise<void> {
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");

    await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      { tokenHash },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    console.log(`🔒 Revoked refresh token: ${reason}`);
  }

  /**
   * Revoke entire refresh token family (reuse detection)
   */
  async revokeRefreshTokenFamily(
    familyId: string,
    reason: string = "token_reuse_detected",
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      {
        familyId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    console.log(`🚨 Revoked token family: ${familyId} (${reason})`);
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all refresh tokens for user
   */
  async revokeAllUserRefreshTokens(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    reason: string = "logout_all",
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      {
        userId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: reason,
      },
    );

    console.log(`🔒 Revoked all refresh tokens for user ${userId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all tokens for client
   */
  async revokeAllClientTokens(
    clientId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    // Revoke access tokens
    await this.accessTokenRepository.update(
      {
        clientId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "client_revoked",
      },
    );

    // Revoke refresh tokens
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      {
        clientId,
        tenantId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
      },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "client_revoked",
      },
    );

    console.log(`🔒 Revoked all tokens for client ${clientId}`);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ID TOKENS (OIDC)
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Create ID token (JWT with user claims)
   */
  async createIDToken(
    user: User,
    client: OAuthClient,
    nonce?: string,
  ): Promise<string> {
    const exp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + client.idTokenTtl;
    const iat = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

    // Build ID token payload (OIDC standard claims)
    const payload: any = {
      iss: this.configService.get("JWT_ISSUER", "https://auth.fortknox.io"),
      sub: user.id,
      aud: client.clientId,
      exp,
      iat,

      // Standard OIDC claims
      email: user.email,
      email_verified: user.emailVerified,
      name: `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName}`.trim(),
      given_name: user.firstName,
      family_name: user.lastName,

      // Include nonce for replay protection
      nonce,
    };

    // Add optional claims
    if (user.avatarUrl) {
      payload.picture = user.avatarUrl;
    }

    // Sign ID token
    const idToken = this.jwtService.sign(payload, {
      secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
      expiresIn: client.idTokenTtl,
    });

    console.log(`✅ Created ID token for user ${user.id}`);

    return idToken;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // CLEANUP
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Clean up expired tokens
   */
  async cleanupExpiredTokens(): Promise<void> {
    const now = new Date();

    // Delete expired authorization codes (older than 1 day)
    const oldCodeDate = new Date(now.getTime() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const deletedCodes = await this.authCodeRepository.delete({
      expiresAt: LessThan(oldCodeDate),
    });

    // Delete expired access tokens (older than 1 day)
    const deletedAccessTokens = await this.accessTokenRepository.delete({
      expiresAt: LessThan(oldCodeDate),
    });

    // Delete expired refresh tokens (older than 30 days)
    const oldRefreshDate = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const deletedRefreshTokens = await this.refreshTokenRepository.delete({
      expiresAt: LessThan(oldRefreshDate),
    });

    console.log(`🧹 Cleaned up expired tokens:`, {
      codes: deletedCodes.affected || 0,
      accessTokens: deletedAccessTokens.affected || 0,
      refreshTokens: deletedRefreshTokens.affected || 0,
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // INTROSPECTION
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Introspect token (get metadata)
   */
  async introspectToken(
    token: string,
    tokenTypeHint?: "access_token" | "refresh_token",
  ): Promise<any> {
    // Try as JWT first (access token)
    try {
      const payload = this.jwtService.verify(token, {
        secret: this.configService.get("JWT_SECRET"),
      });

      const jti = payload.jti;
      const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(jti).digest("hex");

      const accessToken = await this.accessTokenRepository.findOne({
        where: { tokenHash },
      });

      if (!accessToken || accessToken.revokedAt) {
        return { active: false };
      }

      return {
        active: true,
        scope: accessToken.scope,
        client_id: payload.client_id,
        username: payload.email,
        token_type: "Bearer",
        exp: payload.exp,
        iat: payload.iat,
        sub: payload.sub,
        aud: payload.aud,
      };
    } catch {
      // Not a JWT, try as refresh token
      const tokenHash = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");

      const refreshToken = await this.refreshTokenRepository.findOne({
        where: { tokenHash },
        relations: ["client", "user"],
      });

      if (
        !refreshToken ||
        refreshToken.revokedAt ||
        refreshToken.expiresAt < new Date()
      ) {
        return { active: false };
      }

      return {
        active: true,
        scope: refreshToken.scope,
        client_id: refreshToken.client.clientId,
        username: refreshToken.user.email,
        token_type: "refresh_token",
        exp: Math.floor(refreshToken.expiresAt.getTime() / 1000),
        sub: refreshToken.userId,
      };
    }
  }
}

// apps/auth-service/src/modules/rbac/decorators/rbac.decorators.ts

import { SetMetadata } from "@nestjs/common";
import { PERMISSIONS_KEY } from "../guards/permissions.guard";
import { ROLES_KEY } from "../guards/roles.guard";

/**
 * Decorator to require specific permissions
 *
 * @example
 * @RequirePermissions('users:write', 'users:delete')
 * @UseGuards(JwtGuard, PermissionsGuard)
 * async deleteUser() { ... }
 */
export const RequirePermissions = (...permissions: string[]) =>
  SetMetadata(PERMISSIONS_KEY, permissions);

/**
 * Decorator to require specific roles
 *
 * @example
 * @RequireRoles('admin', 'developer')
 * @UseGuards(JwtGuard, RolesGuard)
 * async manageSettings() { ... }
 */
export const RequireRoles = (...roles: string[]) =>
  SetMetadata(ROLES_KEY, roles);

/**
 * Decorator to require admin role
 *
 * @example
 * @RequireAdmin()
 * @UseGuards(JwtGuard, RolesGuard)
 * async deleteAll() { ... }
 */
export const RequireAdmin = () =>
  SetMetadata(ROLES_KEY, ["admin", "super_admin"]);

// apps/auth-service/src/modules/rbac/guards/permissions.guard.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  CanActivate,
  ExecutionContext,
  ForbiddenException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { Reflector } from "@nestjs/core";
import { RbacService } from "../services/rbac.service";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { User } from "@repo/database";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";

export const PERMISSIONS_KEY = "permissions";

/**
 * Guard to check if user has required permissions
 *
 * Usage:
 * @RequirePermissions('users:write', 'users:delete')
 * @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
 * async deleteUser() { ... }
 */
@Injectable()
export class PermissionsGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    private reflector: Reflector,
    @InjectRepository(User) private userRepository: Repository<User>,
  ) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    // Get required permissions from decorator
    const requiredPermissions = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<string[]>(
      PERMISSIONS_KEY,
      [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()],
    );

    if (!requiredPermissions || requiredPermissions.length === 0) {
      return true; // No permissions required
    }

    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const user = request.user;
    const tenantId = request.tenantId;

    // Fetch user permissions (TENANT-SCOPED)
    const userWithPermissions = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: user.sub, tenantId }, // ✅ ALWAYS tenant-scoped
      relations: [
        "userRoles",
        "userRoles.role",
        "userRoles.role.rolePermissions",
        "userRoles.role.rolePermissions.permission",
      ],
    });

    if (!userWithPermissions) {
      throw new ForbiddenException("User not found");
    }

    // Extract user's permissions
    const userPermissions = new Set<string>();
    for (const userRole of userWithPermissions.userRoles) {
      for (const rolePermission of userRole.role.rolePermissions) {
        userPermissions.add(rolePermission.permission.name);
      }
    }

    // Check if user has all required permissions
    const hasAllPermissions = requiredPermissions.every((permission) =>
      userPermissions.has(permission),
    );

    if (!hasAllPermissions) {
      throw new ForbiddenException(
        `Missing required permissions: ${requiredPermissions.join(", ")}`,
      );
    }

    return true;
  }
}
