// apps/auth-service/src/modules/rbac/guards/roles.guard.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  CanActivate,
  ExecutionContext,
  ForbiddenException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { Reflector } from "@nestjs/core";
import { RbacService } from "../services/rbac.service";

export const ROLES_KEY = "roles";

/**
 * Guard to check if user has required roles
 *
 * Usage:
 * @RequireRoles('admin', 'developer')
 * @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
 * async manageSettings() { ... }
 */
@Injectable()
export class RolesGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(
    private reflector: Reflector,
    private rbacService: RbacService,
  ) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    // Get required roles from decorator
    const requiredRoles = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<string[]>(
      ROLES_KEY,
      [context.getHandler(), context.getClass()],
    );

    // If no roles required, allow access
    if (!requiredRoles || requiredRoles.length === 0) {
      return true;
    }

    // Get request and user
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const user = request.user; // From JwtGuard
    const tenantId = request.tenantId; // From TenantMiddleware

    if (!user || !user.sub) {
      throw new ForbiddenException("User not authenticated");
    }

    if (!tenantId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException("Tenant context not found");
    }

    // Check if user has ANY of the required roles
    const hasRole = await this.rbacService.userHasAnyRole(
      user.sub,
      tenantId,
      requiredRoles,
    );

    if (!hasRole) {
      throw new ForbiddenException(
        `Missing required role. Required one of: ${requiredRoles.join(", ")}`,
      );
    }

    return true;
  }
}

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Put,
  Delete,
  Body,
  Param,
  Query,
  UseGuards,
  Request,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiBearerAuth,
} from "@nestjs/swagger";
import { PermissionsGuard } from "./guards/permissions.guard";
import { RolesGuard } from "./guards/roles.guard";
import {
  RequirePermissions,
  RequireRoles,
  RequireAdmin,
} from "./decorators/rbac.decorator";
import { RbacService } from "./services/rbac.service";
import { RoleService } from "./services/role.service";
import { PermissionService } from "./services/permission.service";
import {
  CreatePermissionDto,
  UpdatePermissionDto,
  CreateRoleDto,
  UpdateRoleDto,
  AssignPermissionsDto,
  RemovePermissionsDto,
  AssignRoleDto,
  AssignRolesByNameDto,
  SetUserRolesDto,
  CheckPermissionDto,
  CheckRoleDto,
} from "./dto/rbac.dto";
import { JwtAuthGuard } from "@/common/guards";

@ApiTags("RBAC")
@Controller("rbac")
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
@ApiBearerAuth()
export class RbacController {
  constructor(
    private rbacService: RbacService,
    private roleService: RoleService,
    private permissionService: PermissionService,
  ) {}

  // ============================================================
  // PERMISSION ENDPOINTS
  // ============================================================

  @Get("permissions")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("permissions:read")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "List all permissions" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Permissions retrieved" })
  async listPermissions(@Request() req: any) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.permissionService.listPermissions(tenantId);
  }

  @Post("permissions")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("permissions:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Create permission" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: "Permission created" })
  async createPermission(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Body() dto: CreatePermissionDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.permissionService.createPermission({
      tenantId,
      ...dto,
    });
  }

  @Get("permissions/:id")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("permissions:read")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get permission by ID" })
  async getPermission(@Request() req: any, @Param("id") id: string) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.permissionService.getPermission(id, tenantId);
  }

  @Put("permissions/:id")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("permissions:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Update permission" })
  async updatePermission(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("id") id: string,
    @Body() dto: UpdatePermissionDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.permissionService.updatePermission(id, tenantId, dto);
  }

  @Delete("permissions/:id")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("permissions:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Delete permission" })
  async deletePermission(@Request() req: any, @Param("id") id: string) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.permissionService.deletePermission(id, tenantId);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ROLE ENDPOINTS
  // ============================================================

  @Get("roles")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("roles:read")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "List all roles" })
  async listRoles(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Query("loadPermissions") loadPermissions?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.roleService.listRoles(tenantId, {
      loadPermissions: loadPermissions === "true",
    });
  }

  @Post("roles")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("roles:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Create role" })
  async createRole(@Request() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateRoleDto) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    return this.roleService.createRole({
      tenantId,
      ...dto,
      createdBy: userId,
    });
  }

  @Get("roles/:id")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("roles:read")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get role by ID" })
  async getRole(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("id") id: string,
    @Query("loadPermissions") loadPermissions?: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.roleService.getRole(id, tenantId, loadPermissions === "true");
  }

  @Put("roles/:id")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("roles:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Update role" })
  async updateRole(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("id") id: string,
    @Body() dto: UpdateRoleDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.roleService.updateRole(id, tenantId, dto);
  }

  @Delete("roles/:id")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("roles:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Delete role" })
  async deleteRole(@Request() req: any, @Param("id") id: string) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.roleService.deleteRole(id, tenantId);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ROLE-PERMISSION ENDPOINTS
  // ============================================================

  @Post("roles/:id/permissions")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("roles:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Assign permissions to role" })
  async assignPermissionsToRole(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("id") id: string,
    @Body() dto: AssignPermissionsDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const userId = req.user.sub;
    await this.roleService.assignPermissionsToRole(
      id,
      tenantId,
      dto.permissionNames,
      userId,
    );
    return { message: "Permissions assigned successfully" };
  }

  @Delete("roles/:id/permissions")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("roles:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Remove permissions from role" })
  async removePermissionsFromRole(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("id") id: string,
    @Body() dto: RemovePermissionsDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.roleService.removePermissionsFromRole(
      id,
      tenantId,
      dto.permissionNames,
    );
    return { message: "Permissions removed successfully" };
  }

  @Get("roles/:id/permissions")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("roles:read")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get role permissions" })
  async getRolePermissions(@Request() req: any, @Param("id") id: string) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.roleService.getRolePermissions(id, tenantId);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // USER-ROLE ENDPOINTS
  // ============================================================

  @Get("users/:userId/roles")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("users:read")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get user roles" })
  async getUserRoles(@Request() req: any, @Param("userId") userId: string) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.rbacService.getUserRoles(userId, tenantId);
  }

  @Post("users/:userId/roles")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("users:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Assign roles to user" })
  async assignRolesToUser(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("userId") userId: string,
    @Body() dto: AssignRolesByNameDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const assignedBy = req.user.sub;

    await this.rbacService.assignRolesByNames({
      userId,
      tenantId,
      roleNames: dto.roleNames,
      assignedBy,
      expiresAt: dto.expiresAt ? new Date(dto.expiresAt) : undefined,
      reason: dto.reason,
    });

    return { message: "Roles assigned successfully" };
  }

  @Put("users/:userId/roles")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("users:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Set user roles (replace all)" })
  async setUserRoles(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("userId") userId: string,
    @Body() dto: SetUserRolesDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const assignedBy = req.user.sub;

    await this.rbacService.setUserRoles(
      userId,
      dto.roleNames,
      tenantId,
      assignedBy,
    );
    return { message: "User roles updated successfully" };
  }

  @Delete("users/:userId/roles/:roleName")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("users:write")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Remove role from user" })
  async removeRoleFromUser(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("userId") userId: string,
    @Param("roleName") roleName: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    await this.rbacService.removeRoleByName(userId, roleName, tenantId);
    return { message: "Role removed successfully" };
  }

  @Get("users/:userId/permissions")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("users:read")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get user permissions (aggregated from all roles)" })
  async getUserPermissions(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("userId") userId: string,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    return this.rbacService.getUserPermissions(userId, tenantId);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // PERMISSION CHECK ENDPOINTS
  // ============================================================

  @Post("users/:userId/check-permission")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Check if user has permission" })
  async checkPermission(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("userId") userId: string,
    @Body() dto: CheckPermissionDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const hasPermission = await this.rbacService.userHasPermission(
      userId,
      tenantId,
      dto.permission,
    );
    return { hasPermission };
  }

  @Post("users/:userId/check-role")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Check if user has role" })
  async checkRole(
    @Request() req: any,
    @Param("userId") userId: string,
    @Body() dto: CheckRoleDto,
  ) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const hasRole = await this.rbacService.userHasRole(
      userId,
      tenantId,
      dto.role,
    );
    return { hasRole };
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MY RBAC (CURRENT USER)

  @Get("me/roles")

  async getMyRoles(@Request() req: any) {

  }

  @Get("me/permissions")
  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Get my permissions" })
  async getMyPermissions(@Request() req: any) {

    return this.rbacService.getUserPermissions(userId, tenantId);

  @Post("me/check-permission")

  @ApiOperation({ summary: "Check if I have permission" })
  async checkMyPermission(

  // ============================================================

  @Post("initialize")

    summary: "Initialize RBAC for tenant (create default permissions & roles)",

  async initializeTenant(@Request() req: any) {

// apps/auth-service/src/modules/rbac/services/permission.service.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { Permission } from "@repo/database";

export interface CreatePermissionDto {
  tenantId: string;
  name: string;
  resource: string;
  action: string;
  description?: string;
  scope?: string;
  isSystem?: boolean;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface UpdatePermissionDto {
  description?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

@Injectable()
export class PermissionService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Permission)
    private permissionRepository: Repository<Permission>,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Create a new permission
   */
  async createPermission(data: CreatePermissionDto): Promise<Permission> {
    // Build permission name if not provided
    const name = data.name || `${data.resource}:${data.action}`;

    // Check if permission already exists
    const existing = await this.permissionRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId: data.tenantId,
        name,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException(`Permission ${name} already exists`);
    }

    const permission = await this.permissionRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      name,
      resource: data.resource,
      action: data.action,
      description: data.description,
      scope: data.scope || "tenant",
      isSystem: data.isSystem || false,
      metadata: data.metadata,
    });

    console.log(`✅ Created permission: ${permission.name}`);

    return permission;
  }

  /**
   * Bulk create permissions
   */
  async bulkCreatePermissions(
    tenantId: string,
    permissions: Array<{
      resource: string;
      action: string;
      description?: string;
    }>,
  ): Promise<Permission[]> {
    const created: Permission[] = [];

    for (const perm of permissions) {
      try {
        const permission = await this.createPermission({
          tenantId,
          name: `${perm.resource}:${perm.action}`,
          resource: perm.resource,
          action: perm.action,
          description: perm.description,
        });
        created.push(permission);
      } catch (error) {
        // Skip if already exists
        if (error instanceof ConflictException) {
          console.log(
            `⏭️  Skipping existing permission: ${perm.resource}:${perm.action}`,
          );
        } else {
          throw error;
        }
      }
    }

    return created;
  }

  /**
   * Get permission by ID
   */
  async getPermission(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<Permission> {
    const permission = await this.permissionRepository.findOne({
      where: { id, tenantId },
    });

    if (!permission) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Permission not found");
    }

    return permission;
  }

  /**
   * Get permission by name
   */
  async getPermissionByName(
    name: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<Permission | null> {
    return this.permissionRepository.findOne({
      where: { name, tenantId },
    });
  }

  /**
   * List all permissions for tenant
   */
  async listPermissions(
    tenantId: string,
    options?: {
      resource?: string;
      action?: string;
      scope?: string;
      isSystem?: boolean;
    },
  ): Promise<Permission[]> {
    const query = this.permissionRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("permission")
      .where("permission.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId });

    if (options?.resource) {
      query.andWhere("permission.resource = :resource", {
        resource: options.resource,
      });
    }

    if (options?.action) {
      query.andWhere("permission.action = :action", { action: options.action });
    }

    if (options?.scope) {
      query.andWhere("permission.scope = :scope", { scope: options.scope });
    }

    if (options?.isSystem !== undefined) {
      query.andWhere("permission.isSystem = :isSystem", {
        isSystem: options.isSystem,
      });
    }

    query
      .orderBy("permission.resource", "ASC")
      .addOrderBy("permission.action", "ASC");

    return query.getMany();
  }

  /**
   * Get permissions grouped by resource
   */
  async getPermissionsByResource(
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<Record<string, Permission[]>> {
    const permissions = await this.listPermissions(tenantId);

    const grouped: Record<string, Permission[]> = {};

    for (const permission of permissions) {
      if (!grouped[permission.resource]) {
        grouped[permission.resource] = [];
      }
      grouped[permission.resource]?.push(permission);
    }

    return grouped;
  }

  /**
   * Update permission
   */
  async updatePermission(
    id: string,
    tenantId: string,
    data: UpdatePermissionDto,
  ): Promise<Permission> {
    const permission = await this.getPermission(id, tenantId);

    if (permission.isSystem) {
      throw new ConflictException("Cannot update system permission");
    }

    Object.assign(permission, data);

    await this.permissionRepository.save(permission);

    console.log(`✅ Updated permission: ${permission.name}`);

    return permission;
  }

  /**
   * Delete permission
   */
  async deletePermission(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const permission = await this.getPermission(id, tenantId);

    if (permission.isSystem) {
      throw new ConflictException("Cannot delete system permission");
    }

    await this.permissionRepository.remove(permission);

    console.log(`🗑️  Deleted permission: ${permission.name}`);
  }

  /**
   * Check if permissions exist
   */
  async permissionsExist(
    permissionNames: string[],
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const count = await this.permissionRepository.count({
      where: permissionNames.map((name) => ({ name, tenantId })),
    });

    return count === permissionNames.length;
  }

  /**
   * Get permissions by names
   */
  async getPermissionsByNames(
    permissionNames: string[],
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<Permission[]> {
    if (permissionNames.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    return this.permissionRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("permission")
      .where("permission.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .andWhere("permission.name IN (:...names)", { names: permissionNames })
      .getMany();
  }

  /**
   * Seed default permissions for a tenant
   */
  async seedDefaultPermissions(tenantId: string): Promise<Permission[]> {
    const defaultPermissions = [
      // User permissions
      { resource: "users", action: "read", description: "View users" },
      {
        resource: "users",
        action: "write",
        description: "Create/update users",
      },
      { resource: "users", action: "delete", description: "Delete users" },
      { resource: "users", action: "*", description: "All user permissions" },

      // Role permissions
      { resource: "roles", action: "read", description: "View roles" },
      {
        resource: "roles",
        action: "write",
        description: "Create/update roles",
      },
      { resource: "roles", action: "delete", description: "Delete roles" },
      { resource: "roles", action: "*", description: "All role permissions" },

      // Permission permissions
      {
        resource: "permissions",
        action: "read",
        description: "View permissions",
      },
      {
        resource: "permissions",
        action: "write",
        description: "Manage permissions",
      },

      // OAuth client permissions
      {
        resource: "clients",
        action: "read",
        description: "View OAuth clients",
      },
      {
        resource: "clients",
        action: "write",
        description: "Create/update clients",
      },
      { resource: "clients", action: "delete", description: "Delete clients" },
      {
        resource: "clients",
        action: "*",
        description: "All client permissions",
      },

      // API permissions
      { resource: "api", action: "read", description: "Read API resources" },
      { resource: "api", action: "write", description: "Write API resources" },

      // Profile permissions
      { resource: "profile", action: "read", description: "View own profile" },
      {
        resource: "profile",
        action: "write",
        description: "Update own profile",
      },

      // Super admin wildcard
      {
        resource: "*",
        action: "*",
        description: "All permissions (super admin)",
      },
    ];

    return this.bulkCreatePermissions(tenantId, defaultPermissions);
  }
}

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  BadRequestException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, In } from "typeorm";
import { User, Role, Permission, UserRole } from "@repo/database";
import { RoleService } from "./role.service";
import { PermissionService } from "./permission.service";

export interface AssignRoleDto {
  userId: string;
  roleId: string;
  tenantId: string;
  assignedBy?: string;
  expiresAt?: Date;
  reason?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface AssignRolesByNameDto {
  userId: string;
  roleNames: string[];
  tenantId: string;
  assignedBy?: string;
  expiresAt?: Date;
  reason?: string;
}

@Injectable()
export class RbacService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>,
    @InjectRepository(UserRole)
    private userRoleRepository: Repository<UserRole>,
    private roleService: RoleService,
    private permissionService: PermissionService,
  ) {}

  // ============================================================
  // USER-ROLE ASSIGNMENTS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Assign role to user
   */
  async assignRole(data: AssignRoleDto): Promise<UserRole> {
    // Verify user exists
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: data.userId, tenantId: data.tenantId },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    // Verify role exists
    const role = await this.roleService.getRole(data.roleId, data.tenantId);

    // Check if already assigned
    const existing = await this.userRoleRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        userId: data.userId,
        roleId: data.roleId,
        tenantId: data.tenantId,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      // Update expiry if provided
      if (data.expiresAt) {
        existing.expiresAt = data.expiresAt;
        existing.reason = data.reason;
        existing.metadata = data.metadata;
        await this.userRoleRepository.save(existing);
        console.log(
          `✅ Updated role assignment: ${role.name} for user ${user.email}`,
        );
        return existing;
      }

      throw new ConflictException("Role already assigned to user");
    }

    // Create assignment
    const userRole = await this.userRoleRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      userId: data.userId,
      roleId: data.roleId,
      assignedBy: data.assignedBy,
      assignedAt: new Date(),
      expiresAt: data.expiresAt,
      reason: data.reason,
      metadata: data.metadata,
    });

    console.log(`✅ Assigned role ${role.name} to user ${user.email}`);

    return userRole;
  }

  /**
   * Assign multiple roles to user by role names
   */
  async assignRolesByNames(data: AssignRolesByNameDto): Promise<UserRole[]> {
    // Get roles by names
    const roles = await this.roleService.listRoles(data.tenantId);
    const roleMap = new Map(roles.map((r) => [r.name, r]));

    const assignments: UserRole[] = [];

    for (const roleName of data.roleNames) {
      const role = roleMap.get(roleName);
      if (!role) {
        throw new NotFoundException(`Role not found: ${roleName}`);
      }

      try {
        const userRole = await this.assignRole({
          userId: data.userId,
          roleId: role.id,
          tenantId: data.tenantId,
          assignedBy: data.assignedBy,
          expiresAt: data.expiresAt,
          reason: data.reason,
        });
        assignments.push(userRole);
      } catch (error) {
        // Skip if already assigned
        if (!(error instanceof ConflictException)) {
          throw error;
        }
      }
    }

    return assignments;
  }

  /**
   * Remove role from user
   */
  async removeRole(
    userId: string,
    roleId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const userRole = await this.userRoleRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId, roleId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!userRole) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Role assignment not found");
    }

    await this.userRoleRepository.remove(userRole);

    console.log(`🗑️  Removed role assignment for user ${userId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Remove role from user by role name
   */
  async removeRoleByName(
    userId: string,
    roleName: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const role = await this.roleService.getRoleByName(roleName, tenantId);

    if (!role) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Role not found: ${roleName}`);
    }

    await this.removeRole(userId, role.id, tenantId);
  }

  /**
   * Set exact roles for user (replace all)
   */
  async setUserRoles(
    userId: string,
    roleNames: string[],
    tenantId: string,
    assignedBy?: string,
  ): Promise<UserRole[]> {
    // Remove all existing roles
    await this.userRoleRepository.delete({
      userId,
      tenantId,
    });

    // Assign new roles
    if (roleNames.length > 0) {
      return this.assignRolesByNames({
        userId,
        roleNames,
        tenantId,
        assignedBy,
      });
    }

    return [];
  }

  /**
   * Get user roles
   */
  async getUserRoles(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<Role[]> {
    const userRoles = await this.userRoleRepository.find({
      where: { userId, tenantId },
      relations: [
        "role",
        "role.rolePermissions",
        "role.rolePermissions.permission",
      ],
    });

    // Filter out expired roles
    return userRoles.filter((ur) => !ur.isExpired).map((ur) => ur.role);
  }

  /**
   * Get user with roles and permissions loaded
   */
  async getUserWithRoles(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: userId, tenantId },
      relations: [
        "userRoles",
        "userRoles.role",
        "userRoles.role.rolePermissions",
        "userRoles.role.rolePermissions.permission",
      ],
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    // Filter out expired role assignments
    user.userRoles = user.userRoles.filter((ur) => !ur.isExpired);

    return user;
  }

  /**
   * Get all permissions for user (aggregated from all roles)
   */
  async getUserPermissions(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<Permission[]> {
    const roles = await this.getUserRoles(userId, tenantId);

    const permissionMap = new Map<string, Permission>();

    for (const role of roles) {
      if (role.rolePermissions) {
        for (const rp of role.rolePermissions) {
          if (rp.permission) {
            permissionMap.set(rp.permission.id, rp.permission);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return Array.from(permissionMap.values());
  }

  // ============================================================
  // PERMISSION CHECKS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if user has specific permission
   */
  async userHasPermission(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    permissionName: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.getUserWithRoles(userId, tenantId);
    return user.hasPermission(permissionName);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has any of the permissions
   */
  async userHasAnyPermission(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    permissionNames: string[],
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.getUserWithRoles(userId, tenantId);
    return user.hasAnyPermission(permissionNames);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has all permissions
   */
  async userHasAllPermissions(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    permissionNames: string[],
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.getUserWithRoles(userId, tenantId);
    return user.hasAllPermissions(permissionNames);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has specific role
   */
  async userHasRole(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    roleName: string,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.getUserWithRoles(userId, tenantId);
    return user.hasRole(roleName);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has any of the roles
   */
  async userHasAnyRole(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    roleNames: string[],
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.getUserWithRoles(userId, tenantId);
    return user.hasAnyRole(roleNames);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user is admin
   */
  async userIsAdmin(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.getUserWithRoles(userId, tenantId);
    return user.isAdmin;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // BULK OPERATIONS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Assign default role to new user
   */
  async assignDefaultRole(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    // Get default roles
    const defaultRoles = await this.roleService.listRoles(tenantId, {
      isDefault: true,
      isActive: true,
    });

    if (defaultRoles.length === 0) {
      console.log("⚠️  No default roles found for tenant");
      return;
    }

    // Assign all default roles
    for (const role of defaultRoles) {
      try {
        await this.assignRole({
          userId,
          roleId: role.id,
          tenantId,
          reason: "Auto-assigned default role",
        });
      } catch (error) {
        // Skip if already assigned
        if (!(error instanceof ConflictException)) {
          throw error;
        }
      }
    }

    console.log(
      `✅ Assigned ${defaultRoles.length} default role(s) to user ${userId}`,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Remove expired role assignments
   */
  async cleanupExpiredRoles(tenantId: string): Promise<number> {
    const expiredAssignments = await this.userRoleRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("userRole")
      .where("userRole.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .andWhere("userRole.expiresAt < :now", { now: new Date() })
      .andWhere("userRole.expiresAt IS NOT NULL")
      .getMany();

    if (expiredAssignments.length > 0) {
      await this.userRoleRepository.remove(expiredAssignments);
      console.log(
        `🗑️  Removed ${expiredAssignments.length} expired role assignments`,
      );
    }

    return expiredAssignments.length;
  }

  /**
   * Get users by role
   */
  async getUsersByRole(roleId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<User[]> {
    const userRoles = await this.userRoleRepository.find({
      where: { roleId, tenantId },
      relations: ["user"],
    });

    return userRoles.filter((ur) => !ur.isExpired).map((ur) => ur.user);
  }

  /**
   * Get users by role name
   */
  async getUsersByRoleName(
    roleName: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<User[]> {
    const role = await this.roleService.getRoleByName(roleName, tenantId);

    if (!role) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Role not found: ${roleName}`);
    }

    return this.getUsersByRole(role.id, tenantId);
  }

  /**
   * Get role statistics
   */
  async getRoleStats(
    roleId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<{
    totalUsers: number;
    activeUsers: number;
    expiredAssignments: number;
  }> {
    const userRoles = await this.userRoleRepository.find({
      where: { roleId, tenantId },
    });

    const active = userRoles.filter((ur) => !ur.isExpired);
    const expired = userRoles.filter((ur) => ur.isExpired);

    return {
      totalUsers: userRoles.length,
      activeUsers: active.length,
      expiredAssignments: expired.length,
    };
  }

  // ============================================================
  // SEEDING & INITIALIZATION
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Initialize RBAC for tenant (create default permissions and roles)
   */
  async initializeTenant(tenantId: string, createdBy?: string): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`🔧 Initializing RBAC for tenant ${tenantId}...`);

    // 1. Create default permissions
    const permissions =
      await this.permissionService.seedDefaultPermissions(tenantId);
    console.log(`✅ Created ${permissions.length} default permissions`);

    // 2. Create default roles
    const roles = await this.roleService.seedDefaultRoles(tenantId, createdBy);
    console.log(`✅ Created ${roles.length} default roles`);

    console.log(`🎉 RBAC initialization complete for tenant ${tenantId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Assign admin role to user (convenience method)
   */
  async makeUserAdmin(
    userId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    assignedBy?: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.assignRolesByNames({
      userId,
      roleNames: ["admin"],
      tenantId,
      assignedBy,
      reason: "Admin access granted",
    });

    console.log(`✅ User ${userId} is now an admin`);
  }

  /**
   * Remove admin role from user
   */
  async removeAdminAccess(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.removeRoleByName(userId, "admin", tenantId);
    console.log(`🗑️  Removed admin access from user ${userId}`);
  }
}

// apps/auth-service/src/modules/rbac/services/role.service.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ConflictException,
  BadRequestException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, In } from "typeorm";
import { Role, RolePermission, Permission } from "@repo/database";

export interface CreateRoleDto {
  tenantId: string;
  name: string;
  displayName?: string;
  description?: string;
  scope?: string;
  isSystem?: boolean;
  isDefault?: boolean;
  priority?: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  createdBy?: string;
  permissionNames?: string[]; // Permission names to assign
}

export interface UpdateRoleDto {
  displayName?: string;
  description?: string;
  isActive?: boolean;
  isDefault?: boolean;
  priority?: number;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

@Injectable()
export class RoleService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Role)
    private roleRepository: Repository<Role>,
    @InjectRepository(RolePermission)
    private rolePermissionRepository: Repository<RolePermission>,
    @InjectRepository(Permission)
    private permissionRepository: Repository<Permission>,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Create a new role
   */
  async createRole(data: CreateRoleDto): Promise<Role> {
    // Check if role already exists
    const existing = await this.roleRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        tenantId: data.tenantId,
        name: data.name,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException(`Role ${data.name} already exists`);
    }

    const role = await this.roleRepository.save({
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      name: data.name,
      displayName: data.displayName,
      description: data.description,
      scope: data.scope || "tenant",
      isSystem: data.isSystem || false,
      isActive: true,
      isDefault: data.isDefault || false,
      priority: data.priority || 0,
      metadata: data.metadata,
      createdBy: data.createdBy,
    });

    // Assign permissions if provided
    if (data.permissionNames && data.permissionNames.length > 0) {
      await this.assignPermissionsToRole(
        role.id,
        data.tenantId,
        data.permissionNames,
        data.createdBy,
      );
    }

    console.log(`✅ Created role: ${role.name}`);

    return role;
  }

  /**
   * Get role by ID
   */
  async getRole(
    id: string,
    tenantId: string,
    loadPermissions = false,
  ): Promise<Role> {
    const query = this.roleRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("role")
      .where("role.id = :id", { id })
      .andWhere("role.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId });

    if (loadPermissions) {
      query
        .leftJoinAndSelect("role.rolePermissions", "rolePermission")
        .leftJoinAndSelect("rolePermission.permission", "permission");
    }

    const role = await query.getOne();

    if (!role) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Role not found");
    }

    return role;
  }

  /**
   * Get role by name
   */
  async getRoleByName(
    name: string,
    tenantId: string,
    loadPermissions = false,
  ): Promise<Role | null> {
    const query = this.roleRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("role")
      .where("role.name = :name", { name })
      .andWhere("role.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId });

    if (loadPermissions) {
      query
        .leftJoinAndSelect("role.rolePermissions", "rolePermission")
        .leftJoinAndSelect("rolePermission.permission", "permission");
    }

    return query.getOne();
  }

  /**
   * List all roles for tenant
   */
  async listRoles(
    tenantId: string,
    options?: {
      isActive?: boolean;
      isSystem?: boolean;
      isDefault?: boolean;
      loadPermissions?: boolean;
    },
  ): Promise<Role[]> {
    const query = this.roleRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("role")
      .where("role.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId });

    if (options?.isActive !== undefined) {
      query.andWhere("role.isActive = :isActive", {
        isActive: options.isActive,
      });
    }

    if (options?.isSystem !== undefined) {
      query.andWhere("role.isSystem = :isSystem", {
        isSystem: options.isSystem,
      });
    }

    if (options?.isDefault !== undefined) {
      query.andWhere("role.isDefault = :isDefault", {
        isDefault: options.isDefault,
      });
    }

    if (options?.loadPermissions) {
      query
        .leftJoinAndSelect("role.rolePermissions", "rolePermission")
        .leftJoinAndSelect("rolePermission.permission", "permission");
    }

    query.orderBy("role.priority", "DESC").addOrderBy("role.name", "ASC");

    return query.getMany();
  }

  /**
   * Update role
   */
  async updateRole(
    id: string,
    tenantId: string,
    data: UpdateRoleDto,
  ): Promise<Role> {
    const role = await this.getRole(id, tenantId);

    if (role.isSystem) {
      throw new ConflictException("Cannot update system role");
    }

    Object.assign(role, data);

    await this.roleRepository.save(role);

    console.log(`✅ Updated role: ${role.name}`);

    return role;
  }

  /**
   * Delete role
   */
  async deleteRole(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const role = await this.getRole(id, tenantId);

    if (role.isSystem) {
      throw new ConflictException("Cannot delete system role");
    }

    if (role.isDefault) {
      throw new ConflictException("Cannot delete default role");
    }

    await this.roleRepository.remove(role);

    console.log(`🗑️  Deleted role: ${role.name}`);
  }

  /**
   * Assign permissions to role
   */
  async assignPermissionsToRole(
    roleId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    permissionNames: string[],
    assignedBy?: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const role = await this.getRole(roleId, tenantId);

    if (role.isSystem) {
      throw new ConflictException("Cannot modify system role permissions");
    }

    // Get permissions by names
    const permissions = await this.permissionRepository.find({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        name: In(permissionNames),
      },
    });

    if (permissions.length !== permissionNames.length) {
      const foundNames = permissions.map((p) => p.name);
      const missing = permissionNames.filter(
        (name) => !foundNames.includes(name),
      );
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Permissions not found: ${missing.join(", ")}`,
      );
    }

    // Get existing role permissions
    const existing = await this.rolePermissionRepository.find({
      where: { roleId, tenantId },
    });

    const existingPermissionIds = new Set(
      existing.map((rp) => rp.permissionId),
    );

    // Add new permissions
    const toAdd = permissions.filter((p) => !existingPermissionIds.has(p.id));

    if (toAdd.length > 0) {
      const rolePermissions = toAdd.map((permission) => ({
        tenantId,
        roleId,
        permissionId: permission.id,
        assignedBy,
        assignedAt: new Date(),
      }));

      await this.rolePermissionRepository.save(rolePermissions);

      console.log(
        `✅ Assigned ${toAdd.length} permissions to role ${role.name}`,
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Remove permissions from role
   */
  async removePermissionsFromRole(
    roleId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    permissionNames: string[],
  ): Promise<void> {
    const role = await this.getRole(roleId, tenantId);

    if (role.isSystem) {
      throw new ConflictException("Cannot modify system role permissions");
    }

    // Get permissions by names
    const permissions = await this.permissionRepository.find({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        name: In(permissionNames),
      },
    });

    const permissionIds = permissions.map((p) => p.id);

    // Delete role permissions
    await this.rolePermissionRepository.delete({
      roleId,
      tenantId,
      permissionId: In(permissionIds),
    });

    console.log(
      `🗑️  Removed ${permissions.length} permissions from role ${role.name}`,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Set exact permissions for role (replace all)
   */
  async setRolePermissions(
    roleId: string,
    tenantId: string,
    permissionNames: string[],
    assignedBy?: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const role = await this.getRole(roleId, tenantId);

    if (role.isSystem) {
      throw new ConflictException("Cannot modify system role permissions");
    }

    // Remove all existing permissions
    await this.rolePermissionRepository.delete({
      roleId,
      tenantId,
    });

    // Add new permissions
    if (permissionNames.length > 0) {
      await this.assignPermissionsToRole(
        roleId,
        tenantId,
        permissionNames,
        assignedBy,
      );
    }

    console.log(
      `✅ Set ${permissionNames.length} permissions for role ${role.name}`,
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get role permissions
   */
  async getRolePermissions(
    roleId: string,
    tenantId: string,
  ): Promise<Permission[]> {
    const rolePermissions = await this.rolePermissionRepository.find({
      where: { roleId, tenantId },
      relations: ["permission"],
    });

    return rolePermissions.map((rp) => rp.permission);
  }

  /**
   * Seed default roles for tenant
   */
  async seedDefaultRoles(
    tenantId: string,
    createdBy?: string,
  ): Promise<Role[]> {
    const roles = [
      {
        name: "super_admin",
        displayName: "Super Admin",
        description: "Platform administrator with full access",
        priority: 1000,
        isSystem: true,
        permissionNames: ["*:*"],
      },
      {
        name: "admin",
        displayName: "Admin",
        description: "Tenant administrator with full tenant access",
        priority: 900,
        isSystem: true,
        permissionNames: [
          "users:*",
          "roles:*",
          "permissions:read",
          "clients:*",
          "api:*",
        ],
      },
      {
        name: "developer",
        displayName: "Developer",
        description: "Developer with OAuth client management access",
        priority: 500,
        isSystem: false,
        permissionNames: [
          "users:read",
          "clients:*",
          "api:read",
          "api:write",
          "profile:*",
        ],
      },
      {
        name: "user",
        displayName: "User",
        description: "Standard user with basic access",
        priority: 100,
        isSystem: false,
        isDefault: true,
        permissionNames: ["profile:read", "profile:write"],
      },
    ];

    const created: Role[] = [];

    for (const roleData of roles) {
      try {
        const role = await this.createRole({
          tenantId,
          ...roleData,
          createdBy,
        });
        created.push(role);
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof ConflictException) {
          console.log(`⏭️  Skipping existing role: ${roleData.name}`);
        } else {
          throw error;
        }
      }
    }

    return created;
  }
}

// apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/tenant.service.ts
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  Inject,
  BadRequestException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository } from "typeorm";
import { Tenant } from "@repo/database";
import { CACHE_MANAGER } from "@nestjs/cache-manager";
import { type Cache } from "cache-manager";

@Injectable()
export class TenantService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Tenant)
    private tenantRepository: Repository<Tenant>,

    @Inject(CACHE_MANAGER)
    private cacheManager: Cache,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Find tenant by slug (subdomain)
   * Cached for 5 minutes
   */
  async findBySlug(slug: string): Promise<Tenant | null> {
    const cacheKey = `tenant:slug:${slug}`;

    // Check cache
    const cached = await this.cacheManager.get<Tenant>(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }

    // Query database
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { slug, active: true },
    });

    // Cache for 5 minutes
    if (tenant) {
      await this.cacheManager.set(cacheKey, tenant, 300000);
    }

    return tenant;
  }

  /**
   * Find tenant by custom domain
   * Cached for 5 minutes
   */
  async findByCustomDomain(domain: string): Promise<Tenant | null> {
    const cacheKey = `tenant:domain:${domain}`;

    // Check cache
    const cached = await this.cacheManager.get<Tenant>(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }

    // Query database
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        customDomain: domain,
        customDomainVerified: true,
        active: true,
      },
    });

    // Cache for 5 minutes
    if (tenant) {
      await this.cacheManager.set(cacheKey, tenant, 300000);
    }

    return tenant;
  }

  /**
   * Find tenant by ID
   * Cached for 10 minutes
   */
  async findById(id: string): Promise<Tenant | null> {
    const cacheKey = `tenant:id:${id}`;

    const cached = await this.cacheManager.get<Tenant>(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }
    try {
      const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
        where: { id, active: true },
      });

      if (tenant) {
        await this.cacheManager.set(cacheKey, tenant, 600000);
      }

      return tenant;
    } catch (e) {
      throw new BadRequestException("Tenant Not found");
    }
  }

  /**
   * Invalidate all caches for a tenant
   */
  async invalidateCache(tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: tenantId },
    });

    if (!tenant) return;

    await this.cacheManager.del(`tenant:id:${tenantId}`);
    await this.cacheManager.del(`tenant:slug:${tenant.slug}`);

    if (tenant.customDomain) {
      await this.cacheManager.del(`tenant:domain:${tenant.customDomain}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create tenant (for platform admin)
   */
  async create(data: {
    slug: string;
    name: string;
    environment?: string;
  }): Promise<Tenant> {
    const tenant = this.tenantRepository.create({
      slug: data.slug.toLowerCase(),
      name: data.name,
      environment: data.environment || "production",
      active: true,
    });

    return this.tenantRepository.save(tenant);
  }

  /**
   * Set custom domain
   */
  async setCustomDomain(tenantId: string, domain: string): Promise<Tenant> {
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: tenantId },
    });

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Tenant not found");
    }

    tenant.customDomain = domain;
    tenant.customDomainVerified = false; // Require verification

    await this.tenantRepository.save(tenant);
    await this.invalidateCache(tenantId);

    return tenant;
  }

  /**
   * Verify custom domain
   */
  async verifyCustomDomain(tenantId: string): Promise<Tenant> {
    const tenant = await this.tenantRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: tenantId },
    });

    if (!tenant) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Tenant not found");
    }

    tenant.customDomainVerified = true;

    await this.tenantRepository.save(tenant);
    await this.invalidateCache(tenantId);

    return tenant;
  }
}

  async deleteAccount(@Request() req: any, @Body("password") password: string) {

    await this.userService.deleteAccount(tenantId, req.user.sub, password);

  @Get()

  @RequirePermissions("users:read")

    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;

    // Convert date strings to Date objects

    if (query.createdAfter) {

    if (query.createdBefore) {

  @Get("stats")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("users:read")
  @ApiOperation({

    description: "Get aggregate statistics about users",

  @ApiResponse({
    status: 200,

  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: "Forbidden - missing permissions" })
  async getUserStats(@Request() req: any): Promise<UserStatsDto> {

  /**
   * Export users to CSV (Admin)
   */
  @Get("export")
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("users:read")
  @Header("Content-Type", "text/csv")
  @Header("Content-Disposition", 'attachment; filename="users.csv"')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Export users to CSV (Admin)",
    description: "Download all users as CSV file",
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "CSV file" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: "Forbidden - missing permissions" })
  async exportUsers(

    @Query() query: ListUsersQueryDto,
  ): Promise<string> {

  }

  /**
   * Bulk update users active status (Admin)
   */
  @Post("bulk/update-status")
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @UseGuards(PermissionsGuard)
  @RequirePermissions("users:write")
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: "Bulk update user status (Admin)",
    description: "Activate or deactivate multiple users at once",
  })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: "Users updated" })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: "Forbidden - missing permissions" })
  async bulkUpdateStatus(@Request() req: any, @Body() dto: BulkUpdateUsersDto) {
    const tenantId = req.tenantId!;
    const adminUserId = req.user.sub;

    const result = await this.userService.bulkUpdateActiveStatus(
      tenantId,
      dto.userIds,
      dto.isActive,
      adminUserId,
    );

    return {

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  UnauthorizedException,
} from "@nestjs/common";
import { InjectRepository } from "@nestjs/typeorm";
import { Repository, MoreThan, IsNull, In } from "typeorm";
import { User, Session, SecurityEvent } from "@repo/database";
import { PasswordService } from "@repo/security";

/**
 * User Service
 *
 * Handles all user management business logic:
 * - User CRUD operations
 * - Password management
 * - Session management
 * - Security event tracking
 */
@Injectable()
export class UserService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
    @InjectRepository(Session)
    private readonly sessionRepository: Repository<Session>,
    @InjectRepository(SecurityEvent)
    private readonly securityEventRepository: Repository<SecurityEvent>,
  ) {}

  /**
   * Find user by ID
   */
  async findById(tenantId: string, id: string): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { id, tenantId },
      relations: ["tenant"],
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    return user;
  }

  /**
   * Find user by email
   */
  async findByEmail(tenantId: string, email: string): Promise<User | null> {
    const where: any = { email };
    if (tenantId) {
      where.tenantId = tenantId;
    }

    return this.userRepository.findOne({
      where,
      relations: ["tenant", "mfaSettings"],
    });
  }

  /**
   * Update user profile
   */
  async update(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    data: {
      firstName?: string;
      lastName?: string;
      displayName?: string;
      phone?: string;
      avatarUrl?: string;
      timezone?: string;
      language?: string;
    },
  ) {
    const user = await this.findById(tenantId, userId);

    Object.assign(user, data);
    await this.userRepository.save(user);

    // Log profile update
    await this.logSecurityEvent({
      userId,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      eventType: "USER_UPDATED",
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
      metadata: { fields: Object.keys(data) },
    });

    return user;
  }

  /**
   * Change password
   */
  async changePassword(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    currentPassword: string,
    newPassword: string,
  ) {
    // Get user with password hash
    const user = await this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHash")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHistory")
      .where("user.id = :id", { id: userId })
      .where("user.tenant_id = :tenantId", { tenantId })
      .getOne();

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    // Verify current password
    const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(
      user.passwordHash,
      currentPassword,
    );

    if (!isValid) {
      await this.logSecurityEvent({
        userId,
        tenantId: user.tenantId,
        eventType: "PASSWORD_CHANGE_FAILED",
        severity: "warning",
        ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: { reason: "invalid_current_password" },
      });

      throw new UnauthorizedException("Current password is incorrect");
    }

    // Validate new password strength
    const validation = PasswordService.validateStrength(newPassword);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        message: "New password does not meet security requirements",
        errors: validation.errors,
        score: validation.score,
      });
    }

    // Check password history
    const passwordHistory = user.passwordHistory || [];
    for (const oldHash of passwordHistory) {
      const isReused = await PasswordService.verify(oldHash, newPassword);
      if (isReused) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          "Password has been used recently. Please choose a different password.",
        );
      }
    }

    // Hash new password
    const newHash = await PasswordService.hash(newPassword);

    // Update password and history
    const updatedHistory = [user.passwordHash, ...passwordHistory].slice(0, 5);

    await this.userRepository.update(userId, {
      passwordHash: newHash,
      passwordHistory: updatedHistory,
      passwordChangedAt: new Date(),
      forcePasswordChange: false,
    });

    // Log password change
    await this.logSecurityEvent({
      userId,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      eventType: "PASSWORD_CHANGED",
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
    });

    // Revoke all sessions except current (force re-login on other devices)
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { userId, revokedAt: IsNull() },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "password_changed",
      },
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get active sessions for user
   */
  async getActiveSessions(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    const sessions = await this.sessionRepository.find({
      where: {
        userId,
        revokedAt: IsNull(),
        tenantId,
        expiresAt: MoreThan(new Date()),
      },
      order: {
        lastActivity: "DESC",
      },
    });

    return sessions.map((session) => ({
      id: session.id,
      deviceInfo: session.deviceInfo,
      ipAddress: session.ipAddress,
      location: session.location,
      lastActivity: session.lastActivity,
      createdAt: session.createdAt,
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Revoke a specific session
   */
  async revokeSession(tenantId: string, userId: string, sessionId: string) {
    const session = await this.sessionRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: sessionId, userId, tenantId },
    });

    if (!session) {
      throw new NotFoundException("Session not found");
    }

    await this.sessionRepository.update(sessionId, {
      revokedAt: new Date(),
      revokedReason: "manual_revocation",
    });

    await this.logSecurityEvent({
      userId,
      eventType: "SESSION_REVOKED",
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
      metadata: { sessionId },
    });
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all sessions for user
   */
  async revokeAllSessions(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { userId, revokedAt: IsNull(), tenantId },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "user_request",
      },
    );

    await this.logSecurityEvent({
      userId,
      eventType: "ALL_SESSIONS_REVOKED",
      severity: "info",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get security events for user
   */
  async getSecurityEvents(
    tenantId: string,
    userId: string,
    limit: number = 50,
  ) {
    const events = await this.securityEventRepository.find({
      where: { userId, tenantId },
      order: { createdAt: "DESC" },
      take: limit,
    });

    return events.map((event) => ({
      id: event.id,
      eventType: event.eventType,
      severity: event.severity,
      ipAddress: event.ipAddress,
      location: event.location,
      metadata: event.metadata,
      createdAt: event.createdAt,
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Delete account (soft delete)
   */
  async deleteAccount(tenantId: string, userId: string, password: string) {
    // Get user with password hash
    const user = await this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .addSelect("user.passwordHash")
      .where("user.id = :id", { id: userId })
      .where("user.tenant_id = :id", { id: tenantId })
      .getOne();

    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException("User not found");
    }

    // Verify password
    const isValid = await PasswordService.verify(user.passwordHash, password);

    if (!isValid) {
      await this.logSecurityEvent({
        userId,
        tenantId: user.tenantId,
        eventType: "ACCOUNT_DELETION_FAILED",
        severity: "warning",
        ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: { reason: "invalid_password" },
      });

      throw new UnauthorizedException("Password is incorrect");
    }

    // Soft delete user
    await this.userRepository.softDelete(userId);

    // Revoke all sessions
    await this.sessionRepository.update(
      { userId, revokedAt: IsNull() },
      {
        revokedAt: new Date(),
        revokedReason: "account_deleted",
      },
    );

    // Log account deletion
    await this.logSecurityEvent({
      userId,
      tenantId: user.tenantId,
      eventType: "ACCOUNT_DELETED",
      severity: "critical",
      ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
      userAgent: "system",
    });
  }

  /**
   * Check if account is locked
   */
  async isAccountLocked(tenantId: string, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.findById(tenantId, userId);

    if (!user.lockedUntil) {
      return false;
    }

    return user.lockedUntil > new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Increment failed login attempts
   */
  async incrementFailedAttempts(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    const user = await this.findById(tenantId, userId);

    const newAttempts = user.failedLoginAttempts + 1;

    const update: any = {
      failedLoginAttempts: newAttempts,
    };

    // Lock account after 5 failed attempts
    if (newAttempts >= 5) {
      update.lockedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000); // 15 minutes

      await this.logSecurityEvent({
        userId,
        tenantId: user.tenantId,
        eventType: "ACCOUNT_LOCKED",
        severity: "critical",
        ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: { attempts: newAttempts },
      });
    }

    await this.userRepository.update(userId, update);
  }

  /**
   * Reset failed login attempts
   */
  async resetFailedAttempts(tenantId: string, userId: string) {
    await this.userRepository.update(userId, {
      failedLoginAttempts: 0,
      lockedUntil: undefined,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Update last login timestamp
   */
  async updateLastLogin(tenantId: string, userId: string, ip: string) {
    await this.userRepository.update(userId, {
      lastLoginAt: new Date(),
      lastLoginIp: ip,
      failedLoginAttempts: 0,
      lockedUntil: undefined,
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ADD THIS METHOD TO UserService CLASS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * List users with pagination, filtering, and search
   *
   * @param tenantId - Tenant ID to filter users
   * @param options - Pagination and filtering options
   * @returns Paginated list of users
   *
   * @example
   * // Simple pagination
   * const result = await userService.listUsers(tenantId, { page: 1, limit: 20 });
   *
   * @example
   * // With search
   * const result = await userService.listUsers(tenantId, {
   *   page: 1,
   *   limit: 20,
   *   search: 'john',
   * });
   *
   * @example
   * // With filters
   * const result = await userService.listUsers(tenantId, {
   *   page: 1,
   *   limit: 20,
   *   emailVerified: true,
   *   isActive: true,
   *   sortBy: 'createdAt',
   *   sortOrder: 'DESC',
   * });
   */
  async listUsers(
    tenantId: string,
    options: ListUsersOptions = {},
  ): Promise<PaginatedUsersResponse> {
    // Default values
    const page = Math.max(1, options.page || 1);
    const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, options.limit || 20)); // Max 100 per page
    const sortBy = options.sortBy || "createdAt";
    const sortOrder = options.sortOrder || "DESC";
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    // Validate sortBy field
    const allowedSortFields = [
      "createdAt",
      "updatedAt",
      "email",
      "firstName",
      "lastName",
      "lastLoginAt",
    ];

    if (!allowedSortFields.includes(sortBy)) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Invalid sort field. Allowed: ${allowedSortFields.join(", ")}`,
      );
    }

    // Build query
    const queryBuilder = this.userRepository
      .createQueryBuilder("user")
      .leftJoinAndSelect("user.tenant", "tenant")
      .where("user.tenantId = :tenantId", { tenantId });

    // Apply search filter
    if (options.search) {
      const searchTerm = `%${options.search}%`;
      queryBuilder.andWhere(
        "(user.email ILIKE :search OR user.firstName ILIKE :search OR user.lastName ILIKE :search OR user.displayName ILIKE :search)",
        { search: searchTerm },
      );
    }

    // Apply isActive filter
    if (options.isActive !== undefined) {
      queryBuilder.andWhere("user.isActive = :isActive", {
        isActive: options.isActive,
      });
    }

    // Apply emailVerified filter
    if (options.emailVerified !== undefined) {
      queryBuilder.andWhere("user.emailVerified = :emailVerified", {
        emailVerified: options.emailVerified,
      });
    }

    // Apply date range filters
    if (options.createdAfter) {
      queryBuilder.andWhere("user.createdAt >= :createdAfter", {
        createdAfter: options.createdAfter,
      });
    }

    if (options.createdBefore) {
      queryBuilder.andWhere("user.createdAt <= :createdBefore", {
        createdBefore: options.createdBefore,
      });
    }

    if (options.role) {
      queryBuilder
        .leftJoin("user.userRoles", "userRole")
        .leftJoin("userRole.role", "role")
        .andWhere("role.name = :role", { role: options.role });
    }

    // Apply sorting
    queryBuilder.orderBy(`user.${sortBy}`, sortOrder);

    // Get total count
    const total = await queryBuilder.getCount();

    // Get paginated results
    const users = await queryBuilder.skip(skip).take(limit).getMany();

    // Calculate pagination metadata
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
    const hasNextPage = page < totalPages;
    const hasPreviousPage = page > 1;

    // Format response
    const formattedUsers = users.map((user) => ({
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      firstName: user.firstName,
      lastName: user.lastName,
      displayName: user.displayName,
      emailVerified: user.emailVerified,
      isActive: user.isActive,
      lastLoginAt: user.lastLoginAt,
      createdAt: user.createdAt,
      updatedAt: user.updatedAt,
      tenant: user.tenant
        ? {
            id: user.tenant.id,
            name: user.tenant.name,
            slug: user.tenant.slug,
          }
        : undefined,
    }));

    return {
      users: formattedUsers,
      pagination: {
        page,
        limit,
        total,
        totalPages,
        hasNextPage,
        hasPreviousPage,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get user statistics for admin dashboard
   */
  async getUserStats(tenantId: string): Promise<{
    total: number;
    active: number;
    inactive: number;
    verified: number;
    unverified: number;
    recentLogins: number; // Last 7 days
  }> {
    const total = await this.userRepository.count({
      where: { tenantId },
    });

    const active = await this.userRepository.count({
      where: { tenantId, isActive: true },
    });

    const verified = await this.userRepository.count({
      where: { tenantId, emailVerified: true },
    });

    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
    sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);

    const recentLogins = await this.userRepository.count({
      where: {
        tenantId,
        lastLoginAt: MoreThan(sevenDaysAgo),
      },
    });

    return {
      total,
      active,
      inactive: total - active,
      verified,
      unverified: total - verified,
      recentLogins,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Bulk activate/deactivate users
   */
  async bulkUpdateActiveStatus(
    tenantId: string,
    userIds: string[],
    isActive: boolean,
    adminUserId: string,
  ): Promise<{ updated: number }> {
    if (userIds.length === 0) {
      return { updated: 0 };
    }

    // Verify all users belong to tenant
    const users = await this.userRepository.find({
      where: {
        id: In(userIds),
        tenantId,
      },
    });

    if (users.length !== userIds.length) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        "Some users not found or belong to different tenant",
      );
    }

    // Update all users
    const result = await this.userRepository.update(
      {
        id: In(userIds),
        tenantId,
      },
      { isActive },
    );

    // Log security event for each user
    for (const user of users) {
      await this.logSecurityEvent({
        userId: user.id,
        tenantId,
        eventType: isActive ? "USER_ACTIVATED" : "USER_DEACTIVATED",
        severity: "info",
        ipAddress: "0.0.0.0",
        userAgent: "system",
        metadata: { performedBy: adminUserId },
      });
    }

    console.log(
      `✅ Bulk ${isActive ? "activated" : "deactivated"} ${users.length} users`,
    );

    return { updated: result.affected || 0 };
  }

  /**
   * Export users to CSV format
   */
  async exportUsers(
    tenantId: string,
    options: ListUsersOptions = {},
  ): Promise<string> {
    // Get all users (no pagination)
    const result = await this.listUsers(tenantId, {
      ...options,
      limit: 10000, // Max export limit
    });

    // Generate CSV
    const headers = [
      "ID",
      "Email",
      "First Name",
      "Last Name",
      "Display Name",
      "Email Verified",
      "Active",
      "Last Login",
      "Created At",
    ];

    const rows = result.users.map((user) => [
      user.id,
      user.email,
      user.firstName || "",
      user.lastName || "",
      user.displayName || "",
      user.emailVerified ? "Yes" : "No",
      user.isActive ? "Yes" : "No",
      user.lastLoginAt ? user.lastLoginAt.toISOString() : "Never",
      user.createdAt.toISOString(),
    ]);

    // CSV format
    const csv = [
      headers.join(","),
      ...rows.map((row) =>
        row.map((cell) => `"${String(cell).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(","),
      ),
    ].join("\n");

    return csv;
  }

  /**
   * Log security event
   */
  private async logSecurityEvent(data: {
    userId?: string;
    tenantId?: string;
    eventType: string;
    severity: "info" | "warning" | "critical";
    ipAddress: string;
    userAgent: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  }) {
    await this.securityEventRepository.save({
      userId: data.userId,
      tenantId: data.tenantId,
      eventType: data.eventType,
      severity: data.severity,
      ipAddress: data.ipAddress,
      userAgent: data.userAgent,
      metadata: data.metadata || {},
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Pagination options for listing users
 */
export interface ListUsersOptions {
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
  sortBy?: string;
  sortOrder?: "ASC" | "DESC";
  search?: string;
  isActive?: boolean;
  emailVerified?: boolean;
  role?: string;
  createdAfter?: Date;
  createdBefore?: Date;
}

/**
 * Paginated response for listing users
 */
export interface PaginatedUsersResponse {
  users: Array<{
    id: string;
    email: string;
    firstName?: string;
    lastName?: string;
    displayName?: string;
    emailVerified: boolean;
    isActive: boolean;
    lastLoginAt?: Date;
    createdAt: Date;
    updatedAt: Date;
    tenant?: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      slug: string;
    };
  }>;
  pagination: {
    page: number;
    limit: number;
    total: number;
    totalPages: number;
    hasNextPage: boolean;
    hasPreviousPage: boolean;
  };
}

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';

import request from 'supertest';
import { App } from 'supertest/types';
import { AppModule } from './../src/app.module';

describe('AppController (e2e)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication<App>;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const moduleFixture: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      imports: [AppModule],
    }).compile();

    app = moduleFixture.createNestApplication();
    await app.init();
  });

  it('/ (GET)', () => {
