#!/bin/bash
# test-mfa-complete.sh
# Complete MFA integration test script

# Colors
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
API_URL="http://localhost:4000"
TENANT_ID="d9717e9f-64d1-4f7a-8baa-31d2a91d45a7"
EMAIL="test2@example.com"
PASSWORD="SecureP@ssw0rd123!"

echo -e "${BLUE}🔐 Fort Knox MFA Integration Test${NC}"
echo "====================================="
echo ""

# Variables to store between steps
ACCESS_TOKEN=""
TEMP_TOKEN=""
MFA_CODE=""
BACKUP_CODE=""

# ============================================================
# TEST 1: Register User (if needed)
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 1: Register User${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/register" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -d "{
    \"email\": \"$EMAIL\",
    \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\",
    \"firstName\": \"Test\",
    \"lastName\": \"User\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 409 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ User exists or created successfully${NC}"
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Failed to create user (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 2: Login (No MFA yet)
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 2: Login without MFA${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -d "{
    \"email\": \"$EMAIL\",
    \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
echo $response


if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  ACCESS_TOKEN=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.accessToken')
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Login successful (no MFA)${NC}"
  echo "Access Token: ${ACCESS_TOKEN:0:20}..."
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Login failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 3: Setup TOTP
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 3: Setup TOTP (MFA)${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/mfa/setup/totp" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ]; then
  SECRET=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.secret')
  QR_CODE=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.qrCode')
  BACKUP_CODES=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.backupCodes[]' | head -1)

  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ TOTP setup successful${NC}"
  echo "Secret: $SECRET"
  echo "Backup Code (first): $BACKUP_CODES"
  echo ""
  echo -e "${BLUE}📱 SCAN THIS QR CODE WITH GOOGLE AUTHENTICATOR:${NC}"
  echo "Open the QR code in your browser:"
  echo "$QR_CODE"
  echo ""

  BACKUP_CODE=$BACKUP_CODES

  echo -e "${YELLOW}Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app:${NC}"
  read -p "MFA Code: " MFA_CODE
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ TOTP setup failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 4: Verify and Enable TOTP
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 4: Verify and Enable TOTP${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/mfa/verify/totp" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{
    \"token\": \"$MFA_CODE\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ TOTP verified and enabled!${NC}"
  echo "Backup codes saved from previous step"
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ TOTP verification failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 5: Logout
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 5: Logout${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/logout" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Logged out successfully${NC}"
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Logout failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
fi

echo ""
sleep 2

# ============================================================
# TEST 6: Login with MFA Required
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 6: Login (MFA Required)${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/login" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -d "{
    \"email\": \"$EMAIL\",
    \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  MFA_REQUIRED=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.mfaRequired')

  if [ "$MFA_REQUIRED" = "true" ]; then
    TEMP_TOKEN=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.tempToken')
    echo -e "${GREEN}✅ MFA required (as expected)${NC}"
    echo "Temp Token: ${TEMP_TOKEN:0:20}..."
  else
    echo -e "${RED}❌ MFA not required (unexpected)${NC}"
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Login failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo -e "${YELLOW}Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app:${NC}"
read -p "MFA Code: " MFA_CODE
echo ""

# ============================================================
# TEST 7: Verify MFA Code
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 7: Verify MFA Code${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/mfa/verify" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
  -d "{
    \"tempToken\": \"$TEMP_TOKEN\",
    \"code\": \"$MFA_CODE\"
  }")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  NEW_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.accessToken')
  NEW_REFRESH_TOKEN=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.data.refreshToken')

  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ MFA verified successfully!${NC}"
  echo "New Access Token: ${NEW_ACCESS_TOKEN:0:20}..."
  echo "New Refresh Token: ${NEW_REFRESH_TOKEN:0:20}..."

  ACCESS_TOKEN=$NEW_ACCESS_TOKEN
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ MFA verification failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
  echo "$body"
  exit 1
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 8: Check MFA Status
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 8: Check MFA Status${NC}"
echo "---"

response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X GET "$API_URL/mfa/status" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID")

http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
  echo -e "${GREEN}✅ MFA status retrieved${NC}"
  echo "$body" | jq '.'
else
  echo -e "${RED}❌ Failed to get MFA status (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
fi

echo ""
sleep 1

# ============================================================
# TEST 9: Test Backup Code (Optional)
# ============================================================

echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Test 9: Test Backup Code (Optional)${NC}"
echo "---"
read -p "Do you want to test backup code? (y/n): " TEST_BACKUP

if [ "$TEST_BACKUP" = "y" ]; then
  # Logout first
  curl -s -X POST "$API_URL/auth/logout" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
    -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" > /dev/null

  # Login to get temp token
  response=$(curl -s -X POST "$API_URL/auth/login" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
    -d "{
      \"email\": \"$EMAIL\",
      \"password\": \"$PASSWORD\"
    }")

  TEMP_TOKEN=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.data.tempToken')

  # Verify with backup code
  response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$API_URL/auth/mfa/verify-backup" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "X-Tenant-ID: $TENANT_ID" \
    -d "{
      \"tempToken\": \"$TEMP_TOKEN\",
      \"code\": \"$BACKUP_CODE\"
    }")

  http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n 1)
  body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

  if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Backup code verified successfully!${NC}"
    echo "$body" | jq '.'
  else
    echo -e "${RED}❌ Backup code verification failed (HTTP $http_code)${NC}"
    echo "$body"
  fi
else
  echo "Skipped backup code test"
fi

echo ""
echo "====================================="
echo -e "${GREEN}🎉 All MFA Tests Completed!${NC}"
echo "====================================="
echo ""
echo "Summary:"
echo "✅ User registration/login"
echo "✅ TOTP setup with QR code"
echo "✅ TOTP verification and enablement"
echo "✅ Login with MFA required"
echo "✅ MFA code verification"
echo "✅ MFA status check"
if [ "$TEST_BACKUP" = "y" ]; then
  echo "✅ Backup code verification"
fi
echo ""
echo -e "${BLUE}Your MFA is now fully functional!${NC}"

This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) project bootstrapped with [`create-next-app`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/create-next-app).

## Getting Started

First, run the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
# or
yarn dev
# or
pnpm dev
# or
bun dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) with your browser to see the result.

You can start editing the page by modifying `app/page.tsx`. The page auto-updates as you edit the file.

This project uses [`next/font`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/optimizing/fonts) to automatically optimize and load Inter, a custom Google Font.

## Learn More

To learn more about Next.js, take a look at the following resources:

- [Next.js Documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs) - learn about Next.js features and API.
- [Learn Next.js](https://nextjs.org/learn) - an interactive Next.js tutorial.

You can check out [the Next.js GitHub repository](https://github.com/vercel/next.js) - your feedback and contributions are welcome!

## Deploy on Vercel

The easiest way to deploy your Next.js app is to use the [Vercel Platform](https://vercel.com/new?utm_medium=default-template&filter=next.js&utm_source=create-next-app&utm_campaign=create-next-app-readme) from the creators of Next.js.

Check out our [Next.js deployment documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/deploying) for more details.

:root {
  --background: #ffffff;
  --foreground: #171717;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --background: #0a0a0a;
    --foreground: #ededed;
  }
}

html,
body {
  max-width: 100vw;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

body {
  color: var(--foreground);
  background: var(--background);
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.imgDark {
  display: none;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  html {
    color-scheme: dark;
  }

  .imgLight {
    display: none;
  }
  .imgDark {
    display: unset;
  }
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import localFont from "next/font/local";
import "./globals.css";

const geistSans = localFont({
  src: "./fonts/GeistVF.woff",
  variable: "--font-geist-sans",
});
const geistMono = localFont({
  src: "./fonts/GeistMonoVF.woff",
  variable: "--font-geist-mono",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Create Next App",
  description: "Generated by create next app",
};

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body className={`${geistSans.variable} ${geistMono.variable}`}>
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

import Image, { type ImageProps } from "next/image";
import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button";
import styles from "./page.module.css";

type Props = Omit<ImageProps, "src"> & {
  srcLight: string;
  srcDark: string;
};

const ThemeImage = (props: Props) => {
  const { srcLight, srcDark, ...rest } = props;

  return (
    <>
      <Image {...rest} src={srcLight} className="imgLight" />
      <Image {...rest} src={srcDark} className="imgDark" />
    </>
  );
};

export default function Home() {
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <main className={styles.main}>
        <ThemeImage
          className={styles.logo}
          srcLight="turborepo-dark.svg"
          srcDark="turborepo-light.svg"
          alt="Turborepo logo"
          width={180}
          height={38}
          priority
        />
        <ol>
          <li>
            Get started by editing <code>apps/docs/app/page.tsx</code>
          </li>
          <li>Save and see your changes instantly.</li>
        </ol>

        <div className={styles.ctas}>
          <a
            className={styles.primary}
            href="https://vercel.com/new/clone?demo-description=Learn+to+implement+a+monorepo+with+a+two+Next.js+sites+that+has+installed+three+local+packages.&demo-image=%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2Fe5382hct74si%2F4K8ZISWAzJ8X1504ca0zmC%2F0b21a1c6246add355e55816278ef54bc%2FBasic.png&demo-title=Monorepo+with+Turborepo&demo-url=https%3A%2F%2Fexamples-basic-web.vercel.sh%2F&from=templates&project-name=Monorepo+with+Turborepo&repository-name=monorepo-turborepo&repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fvercel%2Fturborepo%2Ftree%2Fmain%2Fexamples%2Fbasic&root-directory=apps%2Fdocs&skippable-integrations=1&teamSlug=vercel&utm_source=create-turbo"

            Deploy now

import "@repo/ui/globals.css";
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import localFont from "next/font/local";
import Script from "next/script";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@repo/ui/components/theme-provider";

const geistSans = localFont({
  src: "./fonts/GeistVF.woff",
  variable: "--font-geist-sans",
});
const geistMono = localFont({
  src: "./fonts/GeistMonoVF.woff",
  variable: "--font-geist-mono",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Create Next App",
  description: "Generated by create next app",
};

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <Script
          async={true}
          src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-8195619606985915"
          crossOrigin="anonymous"
        ></Script>
        <meta name="google-adsense-account" content="ca-pub-8195619606985915" />
      </head>

      <body className={`${geistSans.variable} ${geistMono.variable}`}>
        <ThemeProvider>{children}</ThemeProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

import Image, { type ImageProps } from "next/image";
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle, Button } from "@repo/ui";
import styles from "./page.module.css";

type Props = Omit<ImageProps, "src"> & {
  srcLight: string;
  srcDark: string;
};

export default function Home() {
  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <main className={styles.main}>
        <Image
          className={styles.logo}
          src={"/logo.svg"}
          alt={"Scrolloop"}
          width={180}
          height={38}
          priority
        />

        <ol>
          <li>Welcome to Scrolloop!</li>
          <li>We're brewing something for you. Stay Tuned!.</li>
        </ol>
        <Button size={"lg"} variant={"default"} className={"bg-primary"}>
          Open alert
        </Button>
        <Alert>
          <AlertTitle>Hi</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription>Theme</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

#!/usr/bin/env node

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

/**
 * Code Consolidator Script
 * Recursively scans directories and consolidates all code files into a single text file
 */

class CodeConsolidator {
  constructor() {
    // Common code file extensions
    this.codeExtensions = new Set([
      ".js",
      ".jsx",
      ".ts",
      ".tsx",
      ".py",
      ".java",
      ".c",
      ".cpp",
      ".cc",
      ".cxx",
      ".cs",
      ".php",
      ".rb",
      ".go",
      ".rs",
      ".swift",
      ".kt",
      ".scala",
      ".r",
      ".m",
      ".mm",
      ".html",
      ".htm",
      ".css",
      ".scss",
      ".sass",
      ".less",
      ".xml",
      ".json",
      ".yaml",
      ".yml",
      ".toml",
      ".sh",
      ".bash",
      ".zsh",
      ".fish",
      ".ps1",
      ".bat",
      ".sql",
      ".graphql",
      ".proto",
      ".thrift",
      ".dockerfile",
      ".makefile",
      ".cmake",
      ".vue",
      ".svelte",
      ".dart",
      ".lua",
      ".pl",
      ".pm",
    ]);

    // Files to exclude
    this.excludeFiles = new Set([
      "package-lock.json",
      "yarn.lock",
      ".DS_Store",
      "Thumbs.db",
      ".env",
      ".env.local",
      ".env.production",
      ".env.development",
    ]);

    // Directories to exclude
    this.excludeDirs = new Set([
      "node_modules",
      ".git",
      ".svn",
      ".hg",
      "dist",
      "build",
      "target",
      "bin",
      "obj",
      "__pycache__",
      ".pytest_cache",
      "venv",
      "env",
      ".venv",
      ".env",
      "vendor",
      ".idea",
      ".vscode",
      ".vs",
      "coverage",
      ".nyc_output",
      ".cache",
    ]);

    this.stats = {
      filesProcessed: 0,
      totalLines: 0,
      skippedFiles: 0,
      errors: 0,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Check if file should be processed based on extension
   */
  isCodeFile(filePath) {
    const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
    const basename = path.basename(filePath).toLowerCase();

    // Special files without extensions
    const specialFiles = [
      "dockerfile",
      "makefile",
      "jenkinsfile",
      "readme",
      "license",
      "changelog",
    ];
    if (specialFiles.some((name) => basename.includes(name))) {
      return true;
    }

    return this.codeExtensions.has(ext);
  }

  /**
   * Check if file/directory should be excluded
   */
  shouldExclude(itemPath, isDirectory = false) {
    const basename = path.basename(itemPath);

    if (isDirectory) {
      return this.excludeDirs.has(basename) || basename.startsWith(".");
    }

    return (
      this.excludeFiles.has(basename) ||
      (basename.startsWith(".") && !this.isCodeFile(itemPath))
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get file size in a readable format
   */
  getFileSize(filePath) {
    try {
      const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
      const bytes = stats.size;

      if (bytes === 0) return "0 B";
      const k = 1024;
      const sizes = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
      const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
      return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + " " + sizes[i];
    } catch (error) {
      return "Unknown";
    }
  }

  /**
   * Process a single file and add its content to the output
   */
  processFile(filePath, outputStream) {
    try {
      const relativePath = path.relative(process.cwd(), filePath);
      const fileSize = this.getFileSize(filePath);
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
      const lineCount = content.split("\n").length;

      // Write file header
      outputStream.write("\n" + "=".repeat(80) + "\n");
      outputStream.write(`FILE: ${relativePath}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`SIZE: ${fileSize} | LINES: ${lineCount}\n`);
      outputStream.write("=".repeat(80) + "\n\n");

      // Write file content
      outputStream.write(content);
      outputStream.write("\n\n");

      this.stats.filesProcessed++;
      this.stats.totalLines += lineCount;

      console.log(`✓ Processed: ${relativePath} (${lineCount} lines)`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`✗ Error processing ${filePath}: ${error.message}`);
      this.stats.errors++;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Recursively scan directory and process all code files
   */
  scanDirectory(dirPath, outputStream) {
    try {
      const items = fs.readdirSync(dirPath);

      for (const item of items) {
        const itemPath = path.join(dirPath, item);
        const stats = fs.statSync(itemPath);

        if (stats.isDirectory()) {
          if (!this.shouldExclude(itemPath, true)) {
            this.scanDirectory(itemPath, outputStream);
          } else {
            console.log(
              `⏭ Skipping directory: ${path.relative(process.cwd(), itemPath)}`,
            );
          }
        } else if (stats.isFile()) {
          if (
            this.isCodeFile(itemPath) &&
            !this.shouldExclude(itemPath, false)
          ) {
            this.processFile(itemPath, outputStream);
          } else {
            this.stats.skippedFiles++;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`✗ Error scanning directory ${dirPath}: ${error.message}`);
      this.stats.errors++;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Main consolidation function
   */
  consolidate(inputPath = ".", outputPath = "consolidated-code.txt") {
    console.log("🚀 Starting code consolidation...\n");
    console.log(`Input: ${path.resolve(inputPath)}`);
    console.log(`Output: ${path.resolve(outputPath)}\n`);

    const outputStream = fs.createWriteStream(outputPath);

    // Write header
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    outputStream.write(`CODE CONSOLIDATION REPORT\n`);
    outputStream.write(`Generated: ${timestamp}\n`);
    outputStream.write(`Input Directory: ${path.resolve(inputPath)}\n`);
    outputStream.write(`${"=".repeat(80)}\n\n`);

    try {
      const inputStats = fs.statSync(inputPath);

      if (inputStats.isDirectory()) {
        this.scanDirectory(inputPath, outputStream);
      } else if (inputStats.isFile()) {
        this.processFile(inputPath, outputStream);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Input path is neither a file nor a directory");
      }

      // Write footer with statistics
      outputStream.write("\n" + "=".repeat(80) + "\n");
      outputStream.write("CONSOLIDATION SUMMARY\n");
      outputStream.write("=".repeat(80) + "\n");
      outputStream.write(`Files Processed: ${this.stats.filesProcessed}\n`);
      outputStream.write(
        `Total Lines: ${this.stats.totalLines.toLocaleString()}\n`,
      );
      outputStream.write(`Files Skipped: ${this.stats.skippedFiles}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`Errors: ${this.stats.errors}\n`);
      outputStream.write(`Generated: ${timestamp}\n`);

      outputStream.end();

      console.log("\n✅ Consolidation completed successfully!");
      console.log(`📊 Statistics:`);
      console.log(`   • Files processed: ${this.stats.filesProcessed}`);
      console.log(
        `   • Total lines: ${this.stats.totalLines.toLocaleString()}`,
      );
      console.log(`   • Files skipped: ${this.stats.skippedFiles}`);
      console.log(`   • Errors: ${this.stats.errors}`);
      console.log(`📁 Output saved to: ${path.resolve(outputPath)}`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`💥 Fatal error: ${error.message}`);
      outputStream.destroy();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Add custom file extensions
   */
  addExtensions(extensions) {
    extensions.forEach((ext) => {
      if (!ext.startsWith(".")) ext = "." + ext;
      this.codeExtensions.add(ext.toLowerCase());
    });
  }

  /**
   * Add custom exclude patterns
   */
  addExcludes(files = [], dirs = []) {
    files.forEach((file) => this.excludeFiles.add(file));
    dirs.forEach((dir) => this.excludeDirs.add(dir));
  }
}

// CLI Usage
if (require.main === module) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  const consolidator = new CodeConsolidator();

  // Parse command line arguments
  let inputPath = ".";
  let outputPath = "consolidated-code.txt";
  let customExtensions = [];
  let excludeFiles = [];
  let excludeDirs = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    switch (args[i]) {
      case "--input":
      case "-i":
        inputPath = args[++i];
        break;
      case "--output":
      case "-o":
        outputPath = args[++i];
        break;
      case "--extensions":
      case "-e":
        customExtensions = args[++i].split(",");
        break;
      case "--exclude-files":
        excludeFiles = args[++i].split(",");
        break;
      case "--exclude-dirs":
        excludeDirs = args[++i].split(",");
        break;
      case "--help":
      case "-h":
        console.log(`
Code Consolidator - Merge all code files into one text file

Usage: node consolidate.js [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <path>          Input directory or file (default: current directory)
  -o, --output <path>         Output file path (default: consolidated-code.txt)
  -e, --extensions <list>     Additional file extensions (comma-separated)
  --exclude-files <list>      Additional files to exclude (comma-separated)
  --exclude-dirs <list>       Additional directories to exclude (comma-separated)
  -h, --help                  Show this help

Examples:
  node consolidate.js
  node consolidate.js -i ./src -o output.txt
  node consolidate.js -e "md,txt" --exclude-dirs "temp,cache"
                `);
        process.exit(0);
    }
  }

  // Apply custom settings
  if (customExtensions.length) consolidator.addExtensions(customExtensions);
  if (excludeFiles.length || excludeDirs.length)
    consolidator.addExcludes(excludeFiles, excludeDirs);

  // Run consolidation
  consolidator.consolidate(inputPath, outputPath);
}

module.exports = CodeConsolidator;

# @repo/database

**Fort Knox Database Package** - TypeORM entities and migrations for the authentication system.

## 📦 What's Included

### Entities (7 Core Tables)

1. **Tenant** - Multi-tenant organizations
2. **User** - User accounts with comprehensive security
3. **Session** - Active sessions with device tracking
4. **MfaSettings** - Multi-factor authentication settings
5. **SecurityEvent** - Security audit log
6. **Role** - RBAC roles
7. **Permission** - RBAC permissions

### Features

✅ **Multi-Tenancy** - Complete tenant isolation  
✅ **Soft Deletes** - All entities support soft deletion  
✅ **Timestamps** - Auto-managed created/updated dates  
✅ **UUID Primary Keys** - Better for distributed systems  
✅ **JSONB Fields** - Flexible metadata storage  
✅ **Comprehensive Indexes** - Optimized for performance  
✅ **Foreign Key Constraints** - Data integrity  
✅ **Database Comments** - Self-documenting schema

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Installation

```bash
cd packages/database
npm install
```

### 2. Environment Variables

Create `.env` file in your auth-service:

```env
DATABASE_HOST=localhost
DATABASE_PORT=5432
DATABASE_USER=fortknox
DATABASE_PASSWORD=fortknox_dev_password
DATABASE_NAME=fortknox_auth
DATABASE_LOGGING=true
DATABASE_POOL_MAX=20
DATABASE_POOL_MIN=2
```

### 3. Run Migration

```bash
# Build the package first
npm run build

# Run migration
npm run migration:run
```

## 📚 Usage

### In Your NestJS Application

#### app.module.ts

```typescript
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { dataSourceOptions } from '@repo/database';

@Module({
  imports: [
    TypeOrmModule.forRoot(dataSourceOptions),
    // ... other modules
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}
```

#### Using Entities in Modules

```typescript
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { User, Tenant } from '@repo/database';
import { UserService } from './user.service';

@Module({
  imports: [
    TypeOrmModule.forFeature([User, Tenant]),
  ],
  providers: [UserService],
  exports: [UserService],
})
export class UserModule {}
```

#### Using in Services

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { User } from '@repo/database';

@Injectable()
export class UserService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>,
  ) {}

  async findByEmail(email: string, tenantId: string): Promise<User | null> {
    return this.userRepository.findOne({
      where: { email, tenantId },
      relations: ['tenant', 'mfaSettings'],
    });
  }

  async create(userData: Partial<User>): Promise<User> {
    const user = this.userRepository.create(userData);
    return this.userRepository.save(user);
  }

  async updateLastLogin(userId: string, ip: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.userRepository.update(userId, {
      lastLoginAt: new Date(),
      lastLoginIp: ip,
      failedLoginAttempts: 0,
    });
  }
}
```

## 🗄️ Database Schema

### Entity Relationships

```
Tenant (1) ──── (M) User
                  │
                  ├─── (1) MfaSettings
                  ├─── (M) Session
                  └─── (M) SecurityEvent

Tenant (1) ──── (M) Role ──── (M) Permission
```

### Key Tables

#### Tenants

```sql
tenants (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  name varchar(255),
  subdomain varchar(100) UNIQUE,
  custom_domain varchar(255),
  status enum('active', 'trial', 'suspended', 'cancelled'),
  plan enum('free', 'starter', 'professional', 'enterprise'),
  settings jsonb,
  ...
)
```

#### Users

```sql
users (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id uuid REFERENCES tenants(id),
  email varchar(255),
  password_hash varchar(255),
  email_verified boolean,
  status enum('active', 'inactive', 'suspended', 'deleted'),
  password_history jsonb,
  failed_login_attempts int,
  locked_until timestamp,
  ...
)
```

#### Sessions

```sql
sessions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id uuid REFERENCES users(id),
  token_hash varchar(255) UNIQUE,
  device_info jsonb,
  ip_address varchar(45),
  expires_at timestamp,
  ...
)
```

## 🔄 Migration Commands

```bash
# Generate a new migration (after entity changes)
npm run migration:generate -- src/migrations/MyMigration

# Create an empty migration
npm run migration:create -- src/migrations/MyMigration

# Run pending migrations
npm run migration:run

# Revert last migration
npm run migration:revert

# Show migration status
npm run migration:show

# Sync schema (DEVELOPMENT ONLY!)
npm run schema:sync

# Drop all tables (DANGER!)
npm run schema:drop
```

## 🎯 Common Queries

### Find User with Relations

```typescript
const user = await userRepository.findOne({
  where: { id: userId },
  relations: ['tenant', 'mfaSettings', 'sessions'],
});
```

### Create User with MFA Settings

```typescript
const user = userRepository.create({
  email: 'user@example.com',
  passwordHash: hashedPassword,
  tenantId: tenant.id,
  mfaSettings: {
    totpEnabled: false,
    backupCodes: [],
  },
});
await userRepository.save(user);
```

### Get Active Sessions for User

```typescript
const activeSessions = await sessionRepository.find({
  where: {
    userId,
    isActive: true,
    expiresAt: MoreThan(new Date()),
  },
  order: {
    lastActivity: 'DESC',
  },
});
```

### Log Security Event

```typescript
await securityEventRepository.save({
  userId,
  tenantId,
  eventType: 'LOGIN_SUCCESS',
  severity: 'info',
  ipAddress: req.ip,
  userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'],
  metadata: { method: 'password' },
});
```

### Get User's Permissions

```typescript
const user = await userRepository.findOne({
  where: { id: userId },
  relations: ['roles', 'roles.permissions'],
});

const permissions = user.roles
  .flatMap((role) => role.permissions)
  .map((perm) => `${perm.resource}:${perm.action}`);
```

## 🔒 Security Features

### Password History

The `password_history` JSONB field stores the last 5 password hashes to prevent reuse:

```typescript
// Check password history
const isReused = await Promise.all(
  user.passwordHistory.map((oldHash) => 
    PasswordService.verify(oldHash, newPassword)
  )
).then((results) => results.some((r) => r));

if (isReused) {
  throw new Error('Password has been used recently');
}

// Update password with history
user.passwordHistory = [
  user.passwordHash,
  ...user.passwordHistory,
].slice(0, 5);
user.passwordHash = newHash;
```

### Account Lockout

```typescript
// Increment failed attempts
user.failedLoginAttempts += 1;

if (user.failedLoginAttempts >= 5) {
  // Lock for 15 minutes
  user.lockedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000);
}

await userRepository.save(user);
```

### Session Expiration

Sessions automatically expire based on `expires_at`:

```typescript
// Check if session is valid
const isValid = 
  session.isActive && 
  !session.revokedAt && 
  session.expiresAt > new Date();
```

## 📊 Performance Tips

### Indexes

All critical fields are indexed:
- User email + tenantId (unique)
- Session tokenHash (unique)
- All foreign keys
- Frequently queried fields (status, email_verified, etc.)

### Query Optimization

```typescript
// ✅ Good - Select only needed fields
const user = await userRepository.findOne({
  where: { id: userId },
  select: ['id', 'email', 'status'],
});

// ✅ Good - Use query builder for complex queries
const users = await userRepository
  .createQueryBuilder('user')
  .where('user.tenant_id = :tenantId', { tenantId })
  .andWhere('user.status = :status', { status: 'active' })
  .andWhere('user.last_login_at > :date', { 
    date: new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) 
  })
  .getMany();

// ❌ Bad - Loading all relations unnecessarily
const user = await userRepository.findOne({
  where: { id: userId },
  relations: ['tenant', 'sessions', 'mfaSettings', 'securityEvents'],
});
```

## 🧪 Testing

### Example Test Setup

```typescript
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { User, dataSourceOptions } from '@repo/database';

describe('UserService', () => {
  let userRepository: Repository<User>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({
      imports: [
        TypeOrmModule.forRoot({
          ...dataSourceOptions,
          database: 'fortknox_test',
          synchronize: true, // OK for tests
        }),
        TypeOrmModule.forFeature([User]),
      ],
    }).compile();

    userRepository = module.get('UserRepository');
  });

  it('should create user', async () => {
    const user = await userRepository.save({
      email: 'test@example.com',
      passwordHash: 'hashed',
      tenantId: 'tenant-id',
    });

    expect(user.id).toBeDefined();
    expect(user.email).toBe('test@example.com');
  });
});
```

## 🚨 Important Notes

### DO NOT Use in Production:
- ❌ `synchronize: true`
- ❌ `dropSchema: true`
- ❌ Hardcoded credentials

### ALWAYS Use:
- ✅ Migrations for schema changes
- ✅ Environment variables for config
- ✅ Connection pooling
- ✅ Query parameter binding (prevents SQL injection)

## 📝 Entity Field Reference

### User Entity

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `email` | varchar(255) | User email (unique per tenant) |
| `passwordHash` | varchar(255) | Argon2id password hash |
| `passwordHistory` | jsonb | Last 5 password hashes |
| `status` | enum | active, inactive, suspended, deleted |
| `emailVerified` | boolean | Email verification status |
| `failedLoginAttempts` | int | Failed login counter |
| `lockedUntil` | timestamp | Account lockout expiration |
| `lastLoginAt` | timestamp | Last successful login |
| `metadata` | jsonb | Additional user data |

### Session Entity

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `tokenHash` | varchar(255) | Hashed session token (unique) |
| `deviceInfo` | jsonb | Browser, OS, device fingerprint |
| `ipAddress` | varchar(45) | IP address |
| `expiresAt` | timestamp | Session expiration |
| `lastActivity` | timestamp | Last activity timestamp |
| `revokedAt` | timestamp | Manual revocation time |

2. Export from `src/entities/index.ts`
3. Generate migration: `npm run migration:generate`
4. Test migration: `npm run migration:run`

import {
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
  DeleteDateColumn,
  BaseEntity as TypeORMBaseEntity,
} from "typeorm";

/**
 * Base Entity
 *
 * All entities extend this to get common fields:
 * - id (UUID primary key)
 * - createdAt (auto-generated timestamp)
 * - updatedAt (auto-updated timestamp)
 * - deletedAt (soft delete timestamp)
 */
export abstract class BaseEntity extends TypeORMBaseEntity {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn("uuid")
  id!: string;

  @CreateDateColumn({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "created_at",
  })
  createdAt!: Date;

  @UpdateDateColumn({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "updated_at",
  })
  updatedAt!: Date;

  @DeleteDateColumn({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "deleted_at",
    nullable: true,
  })
  deletedAt?: Date;
}

import { Entity, Column, ManyToOne, JoinColumn, Index } from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { Tenant } from "./tenant.entity";
import { OAuthClient } from "./oauth-client.entity";
import { User } from "./user.entity";
import { Session } from "./session.entity";

/**
 * OAuth2 Access Token
 * Short-lived token for API access
 */
@Entity("oauth_access_tokens")
@Index(["tenantId", "tokenHash"], { unique: true })
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["tokenHash"])
@Index(["clientId"])
@Index(["userId"])
@Index(["sessionId"])
@Index(["expiresAt"])
@Index(["revokedAt"])
export class OAuthAccessToken extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Tenant, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "tenant_id" })
  tenant!: Tenant;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "client_id" })
  clientId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => OAuthClient, (client) => client.accessTokens, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "client_id" })
  client!: OAuthClient;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", nullable: true, name: "user_id" })
  userId?: string; // NULL for client_credentials grant

  @ManyToOne(() => User, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "user_id" })
  user?: User;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", nullable: true, name: "session_id" })
  sessionId?: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Session, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "session_id" })
  session?: Session;

  // ============================================================
  // TOKEN
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    unique: true,
    name: "token_hash",
    comment: "SHA-256 hash of access token (JTI claim)",
  })
  tokenHash!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 20,
    default: "Bearer",
    name: "token_type",
    comment: "Token type (always Bearer)",
  })
  tokenType!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // OAUTH2 PARAMETERS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Granted scopes (space-separated)",
  })
  scope?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Audience (client_id or resource server)",
  })
  audience?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // EXPIRY & REVOCATION
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "expires_at",
    comment: "When this token expires (typically 15 minutes)",
  })
  expiresAt!: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_at",
    comment: "When this token was revoked",
  })
  revokedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 100,
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_reason",
    comment: "Why this token was revoked",
  })
  revokedReason?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // USAGE TRACKING
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "last_used_at",
    comment: "Last time this token was used",
  })
  lastUsedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "integer",
    default: 0,
    name: "use_count",
    comment: "Number of times this token was used",
  })
  useCount!: number;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "inet",
    nullable: true,
    name: "ip_address",
    comment: "IP address when token was issued",
  })
  ipAddress?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    name: "user_agent",
    comment: "User agent when token was issued",
  })
  userAgent?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if token is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is revoked
   */
  get isRevoked(): boolean {
    return !!this.revokedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is valid (not expired, not revoked)
   */
  get isValid(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired && !this.isRevoked;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is for a user (vs M2M)
   */
  get isUserToken(): boolean {
    return !!this.userId;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is for M2M
   */
  get isM2MToken(): boolean {
    return !this.userId;
  }

  /**
   * Get scopes as array
   */
  get scopes(): string[] {
    return this.scope ? this.scope.split(" ") : [];
  }

  /**
   * Check if token has specific scope
   */
  hasScope(scope: string): boolean {
    return this.scopes.includes(scope);
  }
}

import { Entity, Column, ManyToOne, JoinColumn, Index } from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { Tenant } from "./tenant.entity";
import { OAuthClient } from "./oauth-client.entity";
import { User } from "./user.entity";

/**
 * OAuth2 Authorization Code
 * Temporary code exchanged for access/refresh tokens
 */
@Entity("oauth_authorization_codes")
@Index(["tenantId", "codeHash"], { unique: true })
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["codeHash"])
@Index(["clientId"])
@Index(["userId"])
@Index(["expiresAt"])
export class OAuthAuthorizationCode extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Tenant, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "tenant_id" })
  tenant!: Tenant;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "client_id" })
  clientId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => OAuthClient, (client) => client.authorizationCodes, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "client_id" })
  client!: OAuthClient;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "user_id" })
  userId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => User, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "user_id" })
  user!: User;

  // ============================================================
  // CODE
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    unique: true,
    name: "code_hash",
    comment: "SHA-256 hash of authorization code",
  })
  codeHash!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange)
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    nullable: true,
    name: "code_challenge",
    comment: "PKCE code challenge",
  })
  codeChallenge?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 10,
    nullable: true,
    name: "code_challenge_method",
    comment: "PKCE challenge method: S256 or plain",
  })
  codeChallengeMethod?: "S256" | "plain";

  // ============================================================
  // OAUTH2 PARAMETERS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 500,
    name: "redirect_uri",
    comment: "Redirect URI used in authorization request",
  })
  redirectUri!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Requested scopes (space-separated)",
  })
  scope?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 500,
    nullable: true,
    comment: "OAuth2 state parameter for CSRF protection",
  })
  state?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    nullable: true,
    comment: "OIDC nonce parameter for replay protection",
  })
  nonce?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // USAGE TRACKING
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "used_at",
    comment: "When this code was exchanged for tokens",
  })
  usedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    name: "expires_at",
    comment: "When this code expires (typically 10 minutes)",
  })
  expiresAt!: Date;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "inet",
    nullable: true,
    name: "ip_address",
    comment: "IP address of authorization request",
  })
  ipAddress?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    name: "user_agent",
    comment: "User agent of authorization request",
  })
  userAgent?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if code is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if code has been used
   */
  get isUsed(): boolean {
    return !!this.usedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if code is valid (not expired, not used)
   */
  get isValid(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired && !this.isUsed;
  }

  /**
   * Check if PKCE is enabled
   */
  get hasPKCE(): boolean {
    return !!this.codeChallenge;
  }
}

import {
  Entity,
  Column,
  ManyToOne,

import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";

export type ClientType = "confidential" | "public";
export type ApplicationType = "web" | "native" | "spa";
export type SubjectType = "public" | "pairwise";
export type TokenEndpointAuthMethod =
  | "client_secret_basic"
  | "client_secret_post"
  | "none";

/**
 * OAuth2 Client (Registered Application)
 * Represents third-party or first-party applications that can authenticate users
 */

  get isConfidential(): boolean {
    return this.clientType === "confidential";

  isGrantTypeAllowed(grantType: string): boolean {
    return this.grantTypes.includes(grantType);
  }

  /**
   * Check if redirect URI is allowed
   */
  isRedirectUriAllowed(redirectUri: string): boolean {
    return this.redirectUris.includes(redirectUri);
  }

  /**
   * Check if scope is allowed
   */
  isScopeAllowed(scope: string): boolean {
    if (!this.allowedScopes) return true; // No restrictions
    return this.allowedScopes.includes(scope);
  }

import { Entity, Column, ManyToOne, JoinColumn, Index } from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { Tenant } from "./tenant.entity";
import { OAuthClient } from "./oauth-client.entity";
import { User } from "./user.entity";

/**
 * OAuth2 Consent
 * User consent for third-party applications
 */
@Entity("oauth_consents")
@Index(["tenantId", "userId", "clientId"], { unique: true })
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["clientId"])
@Index(["userId"])
@Index(["expiresAt"])
@Index(["revokedAt"])
export class OAuthConsent extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Tenant, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "tenant_id" })
  tenant!: Tenant;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "client_id" })
  clientId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => OAuthClient, (client) => client.consents, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "client_id" })
  client!: OAuthClient;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "user_id" })
  userId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => User, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "user_id" })
  user!: User;

  // ============================================================
  // CONSENT
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "simple-array",
    name: "granted_scopes",
    comment: "Scopes the user consented to",
  })
  grantedScopes!: string[];

  // ============================================================
  // EXPIRY & REVOCATION
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "expires_at",
    comment: "When this consent expires (NULL = permanent)",
  })
  expiresAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp with time zone",
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_at",
    comment: "When this consent was revoked",
  })
  revokedAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 100,
    nullable: true,
    name: "revoked_reason",
    comment: "Why this consent was revoked",
  })
  revokedReason?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "inet",
    nullable: true,
    name: "ip_address",
    comment: "IP address when consent was granted",
  })
  ipAddress?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    name: "user_agent",
    comment: "User agent when consent was granted",
  })
  userAgent?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: false,
    name: "remember_consent",
    comment: "Whether user chose to remember this consent",
  })
  rememberConsent!: boolean;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if consent is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    if (!this.expiresAt) return false; // Permanent consent
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if consent is revoked
   */
  get isRevoked(): boolean {
    return !!this.revokedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if consent is valid (not expired, not revoked)
   */
  get isValid(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired && !this.isRevoked;
  }

  /**
   * Check if user consented to specific scope
   */
  hasScope(scope: string): boolean {
    return this.grantedScopes.includes(scope);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user consented to all requested scopes
   */
  hasAllScopes(scopes: string[]): boolean {
    return scopes.every((scope) => this.hasScope(scope));
  }

  /**
   * Check if consent is permanent
   */
  get isPermanent(): boolean {
    return !this.expiresAt;
  }
}

  userAgent?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 100,
    nullable: true,
    name: "device_id",
    comment: "Device identifier",
  })
  deviceId?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // HELPERS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if token is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is revoked
   */
  get isRevoked(): boolean {
    return !!this.revokedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token has been used (for reuse detection)
   */
  get isUsed(): boolean {
    return !!this.usedAt;
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is valid (not expired, not revoked, not used)
   */
  get isValid(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired && !this.isRevoked && !this.isUsed;
  }

  /**
   * Get scopes as array
   */
  get scopes(): string[] {
    return this.scope ? this.scope.split(" ") : [];
  }

  /**
   * Check if token has specific scope
   */
  hasScope(scope: string): boolean {
    return this.scopes.includes(scope);
  }

  /**
   * Check if this is the root token in family
   */
  get isRootToken(): boolean {
    return !this.parentTokenId;
  }
}

// packages/database/src/entities/permission.entity.ts

import { Entity, Column, ManyToMany, Index, Unique } from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { Role } from "./role.entity";

/**
 * Permission Entity
 *
 * Defines granular permissions for actions on resources.
 * Format: resource:action (e.g., users:read, clients:write)
 *
 * Permissions are tenant-scoped.
 */
@Entity("permissions")
@Unique(["tenantId", "name"])
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["resource"])
@Index(["action"])
export class Permission extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // TENANT RELATIONSHIP
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  @Index()
  tenantId!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // PERMISSION DETAILS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 100,
    unique: false, // Unique per tenant via composite index
    comment: "Permission name (e.g., users:read)",
  })
  name!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 50,
    comment: "Resource type (e.g., users, clients, api)",
  })
  resource!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 50,
    comment: "Action (e.g., read, write, delete, manage, *)",
  })
  action!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Human-readable description",
  })
  description?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 50,
    default: "tenant",
    comment: "Scope level: platform, tenant, user",
  })
  scope!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: false,
    name: "is_system",
    comment: "System permission (cannot be deleted)",
  })
  isSystem!: boolean;

  @Column({
    type: "jsonb",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Additional metadata (conditions, constraints, etc.)",
  })
  metadata?: {
    conditions?: string[]; // e.g., ["own_resource_only"]
    constraints?: Record<string, any>;
  };

  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @ManyToMany(() => Role, (role) => role.permissions)
  roles!: Role[];

  // ============================================================
  // HELPER METHODS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Get resource from permission name
   * users:read → users
   */
  static getResource(permissionName: string): string {
    return permissionName.split(":")[0] as string;
  }

  /**
   * Get action from permission name
   * users:read → read
   */
  static getAction(permissionName: string): string {
    return permissionName.split(":")[1] as string;
  }

  /**
   * Parse permission name into components
   */
  static parse(permissionName: string): { resource: string; action: string } {
    const [resource, action] = permissionName.split(":") as [string, string];
    return { resource, action };
  }

  /**
   * Check if permission matches pattern
   * users:read matches users:* or *:read or *:*
   */
  matches(pattern: string): boolean {
    const [patternResource, patternAction] = pattern.split(":");

    // Exact match
    if (this.name === pattern) {
      return true;
    }

    // Wildcard resource (*:read)
    if (patternResource === "*" && this.action === patternAction) {
      return true;
    }

    // Wildcard action (users:*)
    if (this.resource === patternResource && patternAction === "*") {
      return true;
    }

    // Full wildcard (*:*)
    if (patternResource === "*" && patternAction === "*") {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Check if this permission implies another permission
   * users:* implies users:read
   */
  implies(permission: Permission): boolean {
    // Same permission
    if (this.name === permission.name) {
      return true;
    }

    // Same resource, this has wildcard action
    if (this.resource === permission.resource && this.action === "*") {
      return true;
    }

    // This has full wildcard
    if (this.resource === "*" && this.action === "*") {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Get full permission name
   */
  get fullName(): string {
    return this.name;
  }

  /**
   * Check if this is a wildcard permission
   */
  get isWildcard(): boolean {
    return this.resource === "*" || this.action === "*";
  }
}

import {
  Entity,
  Column,
  ManyToMany,
  JoinTable,
  Index,
  Unique,
  OneToMany,
} from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { Permission } from "./permission.entity";
import { User } from "./user.entity";
import { RolePermission } from "./role-permission.entity";

/**
 * Role Entity
 *
 * Groups permissions into named roles.
 * Users are assigned roles, roles grant permissions.
 *
 * Roles are tenant-scoped.
 */
@Entity("roles")
@Unique(["tenantId", "name"])
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["isSystem"])
export class Role extends BaseEntity {
  // ============================================================
  // TENANT RELATIONSHIP
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // ROLE DETAILS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 100,
    unique: false, // Unique per tenant via composite index
    comment: "Role name (e.g., admin, developer, user)",
  })
  name!: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 255,
    nullable: true,
    name: "display_name",
    comment: "Human-readable display name",
  })
  displayName?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Role description",
  })
  description?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 50,
    default: "tenant",
    comment: "Scope level: platform, tenant, custom",
  })
  scope!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // FLAGS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: false,
    name: "is_system",
    comment: "System role (cannot be deleted or modified)",
  })
  isSystem!: boolean;

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: true,
    name: "is_active",
    comment: "Whether this role is active",
  })
  isActive!: boolean;

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: false,
    name: "is_default",
    comment: "Automatically assigned to new users",
  })
  isDefault!: boolean;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "integer",
    default: 0,
    comment: "Higher priority = more powerful (for conflict resolution)",
  })
  priority!: number;

  @Column({
    type: "jsonb",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Additional metadata",
  })
  metadata?: {
    color?: string;
    icon?: string;
    maxUsers?: number;
    features?: string[];
  };

  @Column({
    type: "uuid",
    nullable: true,
    name: "created_by",
    comment: "User who created this role",
  })
  createdBy?: string;

  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  // Many-to-Many via explicit RolePermission entity
  // NO @JoinTable - we have explicit RolePermission entity with metadata
  @ManyToMany(() => Permission, (permission) => permission.roles)
  permissions!: Permission[];

  @ManyToMany(() => User, (user) => user.roles)
  users!: User[];

  // OneToMany to access join table metadata
  @OneToMany(() => RolePermission, (rp) => rp.role)
  rolePermissions!: RolePermission[];

  // ============================================================
  // HELPER METHODS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if role has a specific permission
   */
  hasPermission(permissionName: string): boolean {
    if (!this.permissions) {
      return false;
    }

    return this.permissions.some((permission) => {
      // Exact match
      if (permission.name === permissionName) {
        return true;
      }

      // Check if permission implies the requested one
      const [resource, action] = permissionName.split(":");

      // Permission with wildcard action (users:*)
      if (permission.resource === resource && permission.action === "*") {
        return true;
      }

      // Full wildcard (*:*)
      if (permission.resource === "*" && permission.action === "*") {
        return true;
      }

      return false;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Check if role has any of the permissions
   */
  hasAnyPermission(permissionNames: string[]): boolean {
    return permissionNames.some((name) => this.hasPermission(name));
  }

  /**
   * Check if role has all permissions
   */
  hasAllPermissions(permissionNames: string[]): boolean {
    return permissionNames.every((name) => this.hasPermission(name));
  }

  /**
   * Get all permission names for this role
   */
  getPermissionNames(): string[] {
    if (!this.permissions) {
      return [];
    }
    return this.permissions.map((p) => p.name);
  }

  /**
   * Get permissions grouped by resource
   */
  getPermissionsByResource(): Record<string, string[]> {
    if (!this.permissions) {
      return {};
    }

    const grouped: Record<string, string[]> = {};

    for (const permission of this.permissions) {
      if (!grouped[permission.resource]) {
        grouped[permission.resource] = [];
      }
      // @ts-ignore
      grouped[permission.resource].push(permission.action);
    }

    return grouped;
  }

  /**
   * Check if this is an admin role
   */
  get isAdmin(): boolean {
    return (
      this.name === "admin" ||
      this.name === "super_admin" ||
      this.hasPermission("*:*")
    );
  }

  /**
   * Check if this role can be modified
   */
  get isModifiable(): boolean {
    return !this.isSystem;
  }

  /**
   * Check if this role can be deleted
   */
  get isDeletable(): boolean {
    return !this.isSystem && !this.isDefault;
  }
}

import { Entity, Column, ManyToOne, JoinColumn, Index, Unique } from "typeorm";
import { BaseEntity } from "./base.entity";
import { User } from "./user.entity";
import { Role } from "./role.entity";

/**
 * UserRole Entity (Join Table)
 *
 * Explicit join table for User-Role many-to-many relationship.
 * Allows additional metadata like assignment date, expiry, etc.
 */
@Entity("user_roles")
@Unique(["userId", "roleId"])
@Index(["userId"])
@Index(["roleId"])
@Index(["tenantId"])
@Index(["expiresAt"])
export class UserRole extends BaseEntity {
  // PRIMARY KEY - must be explicitly marked
  // This tells TypeORM this is NOT a simple join table

  // ============================================================
  // TENANT RELATIONSHIP
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "tenant_id" })
  tenantId!: string;

  // ============================================================
  // RELATIONSHIPS
  // ============================================================

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "user_id" })
  userId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => User, (user) => user.userRoles, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "user_id" })
  user!: User;

  @Column({ type: "uuid", name: "role_id" })
  roleId!: string;

  @ManyToOne(() => Role, (role) => role.users, {
    onDelete: "CASCADE",
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: "role_id" })
  role!: Role;

  // ============================================================
  // METADATA
  // ============================================================

  @Column({
    type: "uuid",
    nullable: true,
    name: "assigned_by",
    comment: "User who assigned this role",
  })
  assignedBy?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp",
    nullable: true,
    name: "assigned_at",
    default: () => "CURRENT_TIMESTAMP",
    comment: "When role was assigned",
  })
  assignedAt!: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "timestamp",
    nullable: true,
    name: "expires_at",
    comment: "When role assignment expires (null = permanent)",
  })
  expiresAt?: Date;

  @Column({
    type: "text",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Reason for assignment",
  })
  reason?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "jsonb",
    nullable: true,
    comment: "Additional metadata (conditions, restrictions, etc.)",
  })
  metadata?: {
    conditions?: string[];
    restrictions?: Record<string, any>;
    source?: string; // 'manual', 'auto', 'sso', etc.
  };

  // ============================================================
  // HELPER METHODS
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if role assignment is expired
   */
  get isExpired(): boolean {
    if (!this.expiresAt) {
      return false;
    }
    return this.expiresAt < new Date();
  }

  /**
   * Check if role assignment is active
   */
  get isActive(): boolean {
    return !this.isExpired;
  }

  /**
   * Get days until expiry
   */
  get daysUntilExpiry(): number | null {
    if (!this.expiresAt) {
      return null;
    }
    const now = new Date();
    const diff = this.expiresAt.getTime() - now.getTime();
    return Math.ceil(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  }

  /**
   * Check if assignment is permanent
   */
  get isPermanent(): boolean {
    return !this.expiresAt;
  }
}

  passwordResetExpiresAt?: Date;

  @Column({

  })
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;

  @Column({
    type: "varchar",
    length: 10,
    nullable: true,
    comment: "User timezone (e.g., America/New_York)",
  })
  timezone?: string;

  @Column({
    type: "boolean",
    default: true,
    name: "is_active",
  })
  isActive!: boolean;

  // Relationships
  @OneToOne(() => MfaSettings, (mfa) => mfa.user, { cascade: true })
  mfaSettings?: MfaSettings;

  @OneToMany(() => Session, (session) => session.user)
  sessions!: Session[];

  // ============================================================
  // RBAC RELATIONSHIPS - NEW
  // ============================================================

  // Many-to-Many via explicit UserRole entity
  // NO @JoinTable - we have explicit UserRole entity with metadata
  @ManyToMany(() => Role, (role) => role.users)
  roles!: Role[];

  // OneToMany to access join table metadata
  @OneToMany(() => UserRole, (userRole) => userRole.user)
  userRoles!: UserRole[];

  // ============================================================
  // RBAC HELPER METHODS - NEW
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Check if user has a specific role
   */
  hasRole(roleName: string): boolean {
    if (!this.roles) {
      return false;
    }
    return this.roles.some((role) => role.name === roleName);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has any of the roles
   */
  hasAnyRole(roleNames: string[]): boolean {
    return roleNames.some((name) => this.hasRole(name));
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has all roles
   */
  hasAllRoles(roleNames: string[]): boolean {
    return roleNames.every((name) => this.hasRole(name));
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has a specific permission
   */
  hasPermission(permissionName: string): boolean {
    if (!this.roles) {
      return false;
    }
    return this.roles.some((role) => role.hasPermission(permissionName));
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has any of the permissions
   */
  hasAnyPermission(permissionNames: string[]): boolean {
    return permissionNames.some((name) => this.hasPermission(name));
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has all permissions
   */
  hasAllPermissions(permissionNames: string[]): boolean {
    return permissionNames.every((name) => this.hasPermission(name));
  }

  /**
   * Get all permission names for this user
   */
  getPermissions(): string[] {
    if (!this.roles) {
      return [];
    }

    const permissions = new Set<string>();

    for (const role of this.roles) {
      const rolePermissions = role.getPermissionNames();
      rolePermissions.forEach((p) => permissions.add(p));
    }

    return Array.from(permissions);
  }

  /**
   * Get all role names for this user
   */
  getRoleNames(): string[] {
    if (!this.roles) {
      return [];
    }
    return this.roles.map((r) => r.name);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user is admin (has admin role or admin permissions)
   */
  get isAdmin(): boolean {
    if (!this.roles) {
      return false;
    }
    return this.roles.some((role) => role.isAdmin);
  }

  /**
   * Get highest priority role
   */
  get primaryRole(): Role | undefined {
    if (!this.roles || this.roles.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    return this.roles.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority)[0];
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has expired role assignments
   */
  hasExpiredRoles(): boolean {
    if (!this.userRoles) {
      return false;
    }
    return this.userRoles.some((ur) => ur.isExpired);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // EXISTING HELPER METHODS
  // ============================================================

  get fullName(): string {
    if (this.firstName && this.lastName) {
      return `${this.firstName} ${this.lastName}`;
    }
    return this.displayName || this.email;
  }

  get isLocked(): boolean {
    if (!this.lockedUntil) return false;
    return new Date() < this.lockedUntil;
  }
}

      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS feature_flags JSONB,
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS settings JSONB,
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE;
    `);

    // Step 2: Populate slug from existing data
    // ============================================

    // If tenants have a 'subdomain' column, copy it to 'slug'
    await queryRunner.query(`
      UPDATE tenants 
      SET slug = COALESCE(subdomain, name, 'tenant-' || id)
      WHERE slug IS NULL;
    `);

    // If no subdomain column exists, generate from name or id
    await queryRunner.query(`
      UPDATE tenants 
      SET slug = LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(name, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '-', 'g'))
      WHERE slug IS NULL;
    `);

    // Ensure all slugs are unique by appending numbers if needed
    await queryRunner.query(`
      WITH duplicates AS (
        SELECT id, slug, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY slug ORDER BY created_at) as rn
        FROM tenants
      )
      UPDATE tenants t
      SET slug = d.slug || '-' || d.rn
      FROM duplicates d
      WHERE t.id = d.id AND d.rn > 1;
    `);

    // ============================================
    // Step 3: Make slug NOT NULL after population
    // ============================================
    await queryRunner.query(`
      ALTER TABLE tenants 
      ALTER COLUMN slug SET NOT NULL;
    `);

    // ============================================
    // Step 4: Create indexes (NOW slug exists!)
    // ============================================

    await queryRunner.query(`
      CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tenants_slug 
      ON tenants(slug);
    `);

    await queryRunner.query(`
      CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tenants_custom_domain 
      ON tenants(custom_domain) 
      WHERE custom_domain IS NOT NULL;
    `);

    // ============================================
    // Step 5: Set default environment for existing tenants
    // ============================================
    await queryRunner.query(`
      UPDATE tenants 
      SET environment = 'production',
          active = TRUE
      WHERE environment IS NULL OR active IS NULL;
    `);

import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, randomBytes, scrypt } from "crypto";
import { promisify } from "util";

const scryptAsync = promisify(scrypt);

/**
 * AES-256-GCM Encryption Service
 *
 * Provides field-level encryption for sensitive data.
 * Uses AES-256-GCM which provides both confidentiality and authenticity.
 */

export interface EncryptionResult {
  encrypted: string; // Base64 encoded
  iv: string; // Base64 encoded initialization vector
  authTag: string; // Base64 encoded authentication tag
}

export class EncryptionService {
  private static readonly ALGORITHM = "aes-256-gcm";
  private static readonly IV_LENGTH = 16; // 128 bits
  private static readonly SALT_LENGTH = 32; // 256 bits
  private static readonly KEY_LENGTH = 32; // 256 bits
  private static readonly AUTH_TAG_LENGTH = 16; // 128 bits

  /**
   * Derive encryption key from master key
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @param salt - Salt for key derivation
   * @returns Derived key
   */
  private static async deriveKey(
    masterKey: string,
    salt: Buffer,
  ): Promise<Buffer> {
    return (await scryptAsync(masterKey, salt, this.KEY_LENGTH)) as Buffer;
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt data using AES-256-GCM
   * @param plaintext - Data to encrypt
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @param additionalData - Optional authenticated additional data (AAD)
   * @returns Encryption result with IV and auth tag
   */
  static async encrypt(
    plaintext: string,
    masterKey: string,
    additionalData?: string,
  ): Promise<EncryptionResult> {
    // Generate random IV and salt
    const iv = randomBytes(this.IV_LENGTH);
    const salt = randomBytes(this.SALT_LENGTH);

    // Derive encryption key
    const key = await this.deriveKey(masterKey, salt);

    // Create cipher
    const cipher = createCipheriv(this.ALGORITHM, key, iv);

    // Add authenticated additional data if provided
    if (additionalData) {
      cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from(additionalData, "utf8"));
    }

    // Encrypt
    let encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext, "utf8", "base64");
    encrypted += cipher.final("base64");

    // Get authentication tag
    const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();

    // Combine salt + iv + encrypted data for storage
    const combined = Buffer.concat([
      salt,
      iv,
      Buffer.from(encrypted, "base64"),
    ]);

    return {
      encrypted: combined.toString("base64"),
      iv: iv.toString("base64"),
      authTag: authTag.toString("base64"),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt data using AES-256-GCM
   * @param encryptedData - Encrypted data object
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @param additionalData - Optional authenticated additional data (AAD)
   * @returns Decrypted plaintext
   */
  static async decrypt(
    encryptedData: EncryptionResult | string,
    masterKey: string,
    additionalData?: string,
  ): Promise<string> {
    let encrypted: string;
    let authTag: Buffer;
    let combined: Buffer;

    if (typeof encryptedData === "string") {
      // Legacy format: just the encrypted string
      combined = Buffer.from(encryptedData, "base64");
    } else {
      // New format: object with encrypted, iv, authTag
      combined = Buffer.from(encryptedData.encrypted, "base64");
      authTag = Buffer.from(encryptedData.authTag, "base64");
    }

    // Extract salt, iv, and encrypted data
    const salt = combined.subarray(0, this.SALT_LENGTH);
    const iv = combined.subarray(
      this.SALT_LENGTH,
      this.SALT_LENGTH + this.IV_LENGTH,
    );
    const encryptedBuffer = combined.subarray(
      this.SALT_LENGTH + this.IV_LENGTH,
    );

    // Derive decryption key
    const key = await this.deriveKey(masterKey, salt);

    // Create decipher
    const decipher = createDecipheriv(this.ALGORITHM, key, iv);

    // Set authentication tag
    if (typeof encryptedData !== "string" && authTag!) {
      decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);
    }

    // Add authenticated additional data if provided
    if (additionalData) {
      decipher.setAAD(Buffer.from(additionalData, "utf8"));
    }

    // Decrypt
    let decrypted = decipher.update(encryptedBuffer);
    decrypted = Buffer.concat([decrypted, decipher.final()]);

    return decrypted.toString("utf8");
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt a JSON object
   * @param obj - Object to encrypt
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @returns Encrypted result
   */
  static async encryptObject<T>(
    obj: T,
    masterKey: string,
  ): Promise<EncryptionResult> {
    const plaintext = JSON.stringify(obj);
    return this.encrypt(plaintext, masterKey);
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt to JSON object
   * @param encryptedData - Encrypted data
   * @param masterKey - Master encryption key
   * @returns Decrypted object
   */
  static async decryptObject<T>(
    encryptedData: EncryptionResult | string,
    masterKey: string,
  ): Promise<T> {
    const plaintext = await this.decrypt(encryptedData, masterKey);
    return JSON.parse(plaintext);
  }

  /**
   * Generate a secure random key
   * @param length - Key length in bytes (default: 32 for AES-256)
   * @returns Base64 encoded random key
   */
  static generateKey(length: number = this.KEY_LENGTH): string {
    return randomBytes(length).toString("base64");
  }

  /**
   * Hash data using SHA-256
   * @param data - Data to hash
   * @returns Hex encoded hash
   */
  static hash(data: string): string {
    const crypto = require("crypto");
    return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex");
  }

  /**
   * Generate HMAC signature
   * @param data - Data to sign
   * @param secret - Secret key
   * @returns Hex encoded HMAC
   */
  static hmac(data: string, secret: string): string {
    const crypto = require("crypto");
    return crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(data).digest("hex");
  }

  /**
   * Verify HMAC signature
   * @param data - Original data
   * @param signature - HMAC signature to verify
   * @param secret - Secret key
   * @returns True if signature is valid
   */
  static verifyHmac(data: string, signature: string, secret: string): boolean {
    const expected = this.hmac(data, secret);

    // Use timing-safe comparison to prevent timing attacks
    if (expected.length !== signature.length) {
      return false;
    }

    let result = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) {
      result |= expected.charCodeAt(i) ^ signature.charCodeAt(i);
    }

    return result === 0;
  }
}
